# skills-and-mcp

Claude Code kurulumumda kullandığım **MCP sunucuları, plugin'ler ve skill'lerin** listesi.

Tüm kayıtlar makine tarafından okunabilir şekilde [`setup.json`](setup.json) içinde tutuluyor.

---

> Etiketler: `MCP` dış servise bağlanır · `Skill` Claude'a iş akışı öğretir · `Plugin` skill/agent paketi · `Yerleşik` Claude Code ile gelir · `Ajan` görev devralan ayrı ajan · `Sağlayıcı` ücretsiz model API'si · `Component` projeye kopyalanan UI bileşeni

## 📈 Dijital Pazarlama

### SEO · GEO · AEO

- **[`seo-auditor`](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills)** ⭐ 28k `Skill`: Meta etiket, okunabilirlik, kırık link, sitemap; tek taramada SEO karnesi.

- **[OpenSEO](https://github.com/every-app/open-seo)** ⭐ 23k `MCP` `Skill`: Semrush/Ahrefs'in açık kaynak alternatifi. Kelime, rakip, backlink ve YZ görünürlüğü verisi agent'ının elinde. *(DataForSEO kullandıkça öde)*

  <details>
  <summary>13 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `seo-audit` | Veriye dayalı site denetimi; trafiği en çok büyütecek birkaç değişiklik |
  | `keyword-research` | Kelime fırsatları, metrikler, SERP analizi |
  | `keyword-clustering` | Kelimeleri niyete göre kümeler, sayfalara eşler; cannibalization'a son |
  | `competitor-analysis` | Tek rakibin organik ayak izi, kelimeleri, backlink'leri |
  | `competitive-landscape` | Pazar liderleri, kazanan içerik temaları, stratejik boşluklar |
  | `link-prospecting` | Backlink adayları, iletişim yolu, outreach taslağı |
  | `ai-visibility-audit` | Markan YZ cevaplarında nasıl görünüyor; alıntılanmak için ne yapmalı |
  | `ai-prompt-research` | İnsanlar ChatGPT'ye ne soruyor, kim alıntılanıyor |
  | `local-seo` | Google İşletme Profili denetimi, Maps görünürlük haritası |
  | `seo-report` | Tek sayfalık HTML rapor |
  | `seo-coach` | Rehber mod; sıradaki adımı önerir |
  | `seo-project-setup` | Proje bağlamı: hedef, rakip, ana sayfalar, Search Console |
  | `setup-openseo` | OpenSEO plugin, MCP ve skill kurulumu |

  </details>

- **[`geo-seo-claude`](https://github.com/zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude)** ⭐ 11k `Skill`: Google'da değil, ChatGPT/Perplexity cevaplarında da çık; GEO optimizasyonu.
- **[`seomachine`](https://github.com/TheCraigHewitt/seomachine)** ⭐ 7.5k `Skill`: Anahtar kelimeden yayına SEO içerik fabrikası.
- **[gsc](https://github.com/AminForou/mcp-gsc)** ⭐ 1.9k `MCP`: Search Console verisi sohbette. Hangi sorgu geliyor, hangi sayfa düşüyor, indeksleme neden takıldı; tahmin değil gerçek veri. *(Ücretsiz, Google OAuth)*
- **[geo-optimizer](https://github.com/Auriti-Labs/geo-optimizer-skill)** ⭐ 1k `MCP` `Skill`: ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews sitene atıf yapıyor mu? Princeton'ın 47 yöntemiyle GEO/AEO karnesi; llms.txt, bot erişimi, schema. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[jev-seo](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/jev-seo)** ⭐ 657 `Skill`: Tek bir ana sayfa URL'si ver, site canlı taransın. Google Search Central'a bağlı 52 kural, Core Web Vitals ve sayfa sayfa YZ yargısı; sonunda tasarımlı PDF, Excel aksiyon listesi ve Markdown rapor. *(Jev API isteğe bağlı, sayfa başı ~0,00015$)*

### Reklam & Sosyal Medya

- **[`ads`](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-ads)** ⭐ 9.9k `Skill`: Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok reklam hesaplarına 225+ kontrollü denetim. Boşa giden bütçeyi bulur.
- **[meta-ads](https://github.com/pipeboard-co/meta-ads-mcp)** ⭐ 1.3k `MCP`: Facebook + Instagram reklamlarını sohbetten yönet. Kampanya aç, bütçe değiştir, performansı analiz et. *(Pipeboard, free plan)*

- **[Instagram Agent Skills](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill)** ⭐ 955 `Skill`: Instagram hesabını baştan sona yöneten 13 skill. Viral hook'lu Reel'den DM'e kadar her şey; API anahtarı yok, hesap bağlamak yok.

  <details>
  <summary>13 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `ig-reel` | Ham fikirden çekime hazır Reel; 26 skorlanmış hook formülü, script, beat sheet |
  | `ig-viral` | Nişinde şu an patlayan reel'leri bulur, hook'unu çözer, swipe file çıkarır |
  | `ig-caption` | "... devamı"ndan sağ çıkan, lint'li, 3 hashtag'li caption |
  | `ig-carousel` | Kaydırtan kapak, slayt slayt metin, 1080x1350 dosyalar |
  | `ig-story` | Günün story dizisi; hangi sticker nerede, DM'e nasıl taşınır |
  | `ig-plan` | Haftalık içerik takvimi ve etkileşim listesi |
  | `ig-repurpose` | Tek YouTube videosu ya da podcast'ten bir haftalık reel + carousel |
  | `ig-profile` | Profili 100 üzerinden puanlar, bio/highlight/grid'i yeniden yazar |
  | `ig-audit` | Insights'ı okur: ne tuttu, neden battı, neyi bırakmalı |
  | `ig-dm` | Cevap alan DM; ilk mesaj, collab pitch, iki takip |
  | `ig-comment` | Bot gibi değil, fikri olan biri gibi yorum |
  | `ig-reply` | Kendi yorumlarına öncelik sırasıyla cevap; hater'dan lead'e |
  | `ig-human` | Taslaktaki AI izini siler; em dash, slop kelime, görünmez karakter |

  </details>

## 🎬 Video

- **[Remotion Skills](https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills)** ⭐ 5k `Skill`: React ile kodla video üret. Remotion ekibinin 12 resmi skill'i fikirden MP4'e tüm yolu kapsıyor.

  <details>
  <summary>12 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `remotion-best-practices` | Hepsinin yönlendiricisi; hangisini seçeceğini bilmiyorsan buradan başla |
  | `remotion-create` | "Plak dükkanı için promo video yap" de, proje ve composition hazır |
  | `remotion-markup` | Animasyon, efekt ve yerleşimde Remotion ekibinin kuralları |
  | `remotion-interactivity` | Sonradan düzenlenebilir, interaktif kurgu |
  | `remotion-captions` | Sesi yazıya dök, TikTok tarzı animasyonlu altyazı |
  | `remotion-studio` | Render beklemeden canlı önizleme |
  | `remotion-render` | MP4'e dök; local ya da Lambda |
  | `remotion-maps` | Harita animasyonu; rota çiz, şehirden şehre uç |
  | `remotion-multimedia` | Mediabunny ile video/ses oku, kes, dönüştür |
  | `remotion-saas` | Remotion üstüne video üreten SaaS kur |
  | `remotion-upgrade` | Remotion paketlerini güvenle güncelle |
  | `remotion-docs` | Dokümanda anında arama |

  </details>

- **[Remotion MCP](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@remotion/mcp)** `MCP`: Remotion'ın resmi doküman beyni. Video kodu yazarken API'yi tahmin etme, sor. *(Ücretsiz)*

## 🎨 Tasarım & UI

- **[ui-ux-pro-max](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill)** ⭐ 135k `Plugin`: Cebindeki tasarım ajansı. 84 stil, 192 palet, 74 font eşleşmesi; "AI yaptı" belli olmayan arayüzler.
- **[awesome-design-systems](https://github.com/alexpate/awesome-design-systems)** ⭐ 26k `Skill`: Dünyanın en iyi tasarım sistemleri tek yerde; ilham ve referans.
- **[BoardUI](https://github.com/BoardUI/boardui)** ⭐ 972 `Component` `MCP`: Yapay zekâ ürünleri ve dashboard'lar için 69 ücretsiz React bileşeni: chat, agent log, composer, tablo, takvim, bildirim merkezi. Kaynak kod olarak projeye kopyalanır. React Aria + Tailwind v4. *(Proje bazlı; VisaPapers shadcn kullandığı için değil, başka projede)*
- **[nanobanana](https://github.com/YCSE/nanobanana-mcp)** ⭐ 31 `MCP`: Gemini'nin görsel motoru terminalinde. Logo, mockup, asset üret ya da mevcut görseli düzenle. *(Flash ücretsiz kotada)*
- **[stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup)** `MCP`: Bir cümle yaz, Google komple ekranı çizsin. Figma'yı açmadan tasarım sistemi ve varyantlar hazır. *(Ücretsiz, ~350 üretim/ay)*
- **[21st](https://21st.dev)** `MCP`: shadcn/ui + Tailwind component'leri tek prompt'la. Hazır kütüphaneden çek, kodu direkt projene düşsün. *(100 kredi/ay, hızlı biter)*
- **[fal.ai](https://fal.ai)** `MCP`: Flux, Recraft, Kling gibi yüzlerce görsel ve video modeli tek API'de. Nanobanana yetmediğinde profesyonel kalite. *(💰 Ücretli, tamamen kullandıkça öde)*

## 🛠️ Geliştirme & Kod Kalitesi

- **[php-lsp](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: Laravel/PHP kodunda tanıma ve kullanım yerlerine anında git. *(Ücretsiz, `npm i -g intelephense`)*
- **[typescript-lsp](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: TS/JS projelerde aynı kod zekâsı. *(Ücretsiz, `npm i -g typescript typescript-language-server`)*
- **[security-guidance](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: Kod yazılırken güvenlik açığı uyarısı; ödeme ve kimlik kodunda erken yakalar. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[pr-review-toolkit](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: PR öncesi yorum, test, hata yönetimi ve tip incelemesi yapan ajanlar. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[shopify-ai-toolkit](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: Shopify resmi 18 skill; tema, app ve ödeme tarafı. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[frontend-design](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** `Plugin`: Şablon gibi durmayan özgün arayüz rehberi. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)** ⭐ 298k `Plugin`: Claude'a kıdemli mühendis disiplini aşılar. Brainstorm, plan, TDD, sistematik debug; rastgele kod yazmaya son.
- **[REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea)** ⭐ 253k `MCP` `Skill`: Bir uygulamada beğendiğin özelliği gör, kaynak kodu olmadan nasıl çalıştığını binary seviyesine kadar çöz, kanıtıyla kendi projene uyarla. Native, Electron/JS, .NET ve web. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*
- **[markitdown](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown)** ⭐ 190k `MCP`: PDF, Word, Excel, HTML ne verirsen temiz Markdown'a çevirir. Belge okutmanın en kısa yolu. *(Ücretsiz)*

- **[Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)** ⭐ 161k `Skill`: Odadaki en tembel kıdemli dev gibi düşünür. En iyi kod hiç yazılmayan koddur; YAGNI, stdlib, tek satır.

  <details>
  <summary>6 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `ponytail` | En küçük değişiklikle tam çözüm; lite / full / ultra seviyeleri |
  | `ponytail-review` | Değişikliği sade dille inceler: mantık, güvenlik, yük, test, gereksiz satır |
  | `ponytail-audit` | Tüm repoya kalite denetimi; bug, güvenlik açığı, silinecek kod |
  | `ponytail-debt` | Ertelenen `shortcut:` yorumlarının borç defteri |
  | `ponytail-gain` | Benchmark'tan ölçülmüş tasarruf (kod, maliyet, hız) |
  | `ponytail-help` | Seviye, skill ve komutlar için hızlı referans |

  </details>

- **[graphify](https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify)** ⭐ 142k `Skill` `MCP`: `/graphify` yaz, kod tabanı, dokümanlar, SQL şemaları ve PDF'ler sorgulanabilir bilgi grafiğine dönüşsün; grep yerine soru sor. Yerel AST, vektör veritabanı yok. *(Ücretsiz, henüz kurulmadı; büyük kod tabanında lazım olursa)*
- **[context7](https://github.com/upstash/context7)** ⭐ 63k `MCP`: Eskimiş API bilgisine son. Kütüphanenin bugünkü dokümanını anında çeker, halüsinasyon kodu bitirir. *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[github](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server)** ⭐ 34k `MCP`: Repo, issue ve PR'lar Claude'un elinde. Tarayıcıya geçmeden review, merge, triage. *(Ücretsiz)*

- **[claude-skills](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills)** ⭐ 28k `Skill`: Push öncesi kalite kapıları ve git ritüeli tek komutta. Hata CI'a, sızan anahtar repoya ulaşmadan yakalanır.

  <details>
  <summary>9 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `focused-fix` | Bozuk modülü 5 fazlı protokolle onarır; yama değil kök neden |
  | `review` | Push öncesi yerel inceleme kapısı |
  | `security-scan` | Push öncesi güvenlik taraması |
  | `git/cm` | Conventional Commit oluşturur |
  | `git/cp` | Stage, commit, push tek komut |
  | `git/pr` | Mevcut branch'ten PR açar |
  | `git/clean` | Merge edilmiş branch'leri temizler |
  | `update-docs` | Kod değişince dokümanları günceller |
  | `plugin-audit` | Skill/plugin dizinine 8 fazlı denetim |

  </details>

- **[Google Skills](https://github.com/google/skills)** ⭐ 22k `Skill`: Google'ın resmi 184 skill'i: Cloud, Gemini, Analytics, Ads, Firebase, Sign in with Google. Hepsini kurma, oturum şişer; 5'i kurulu, gerisi lazım olunca tek komutla gelir.

  <details>
  <summary>Kurulu 5 skill + kalanı nasıl eklenir?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `finding-google-skills` | Lazım olan Google skill'ini katalogdan bulup getirir; kalan 179'un kapısı |
  | `google-analytics-data-api-basics` | GA4 raporları: aktif kullanıcı, sayfa görüntüleme, şehir, tarih |
  | `google-analytics-admin-api-basics` | GA hesap/mülk ayarları, veri akışı, dönüşüm olayları |
  | `sign-in-with-google-web` | Google ile giriş + One Tap; Next.js, token doğrulama, CSP |
  | `gemini-api` | Gemini API (Vertex AI) ile multimodal, araç, önbellek, batch |

  Kalanı: `npx skills add google/skills -g -a claude-code -y --skill <ad>`

  </details>

- **`simplify`** `Yerleşik`: Değişen kodu tarar, tekrarı ve gereksiz karmaşayı budar. Kod incelir, okunur olur.
- **[supabase](https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp)** `MCP`: Veritabanı, auth ve storage'ı sohbetten yönet. Dashboard'a girmeden tablo kur, sorgu at. *(Ücretsiz plan)*

## 🤖 Claude İçi İşlevsel

### Token & Model Yönetimi

- **[OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute)** ⭐ 75k `MCP` `Skill`: 370+ sağlayıcı, 150+ ücretsiz tier tek endpoint'te. Kota biterse otomatik başka modele geçer, kodlama hiç durmaz. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*

  <details>
  <summary>45 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `omni-*` (25) | API tarafı: sağlayıcı, routing combo, bütçe, cache, sıkıştırma, MCP, A2A, webhook, tunnel, yedek |
  | `cli-*` (19) | Aynısı terminalden: sunucuyu başlat, sağlayıcı ekle, maliyeti izle, eval koştur |
  | `config-codex-cli` | Codex CLI'yi OmniRoute'a bağlar; config ve 7 profil hazır |

  </details>

- **[headroom](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom)** ⭐ 75k `MCP`: Tool çıktısını, log'ları, JSON'u LLM'e gitmeden sıkıştırır. Aynı cevap, %20-95 daha az token. *(Ücretsiz)*

### Prompt & Agent

- **[agent-sdk-dev](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official)** ⭐ 38k `Plugin`: Kendi Claude agent'ını dakikalar içinde ayağa kaldır ve best practice'e göre doğrulat.
- **[`prompt-master`](https://github.com/nidhinjs/prompt-master)** ⭐ 14k `Skill`: Her AI aracı için nokta atışı prompt; Midjourney'den Cursor'a. Boşa kredi yakma.
- **[`task-observer`](https://github.com/rebelytics/one-skill-to-rule-them-all)** ⭐ 3.3k `Skill`: "One Skill to Rule Them All". Çalışmanı izler, düzeltmelerini yakalar, diğer skill'lerini senin onayınla geliştirir.
- **`claude-api`** `Yerleşik`: Model ID, fiyat, streaming, tool use. Claude ile uygulama yazarken ezbere değil, doğru bilgiyle.

### Ayar & Otomasyon

- **[Claude Code yerleşik skill'leri](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills)** `Yerleşik`: Kurulum gerektirmez, Claude Code ile gelir. Ayarı, zamanlamayı ve kısayolları sohbetten yönet.

  <details>
  <summary>4 skill'in içinde ne var?</summary>

  | Skill | Ne yapar |
  |-------|----------|
  | `update-config` | "Bundan sonra her seferinde..." de, hook'u ve izni o yazsın |
  | `loop` | Komutu aralıklarla tekrar çalıştırır; deploy'u, CI'ı o izler |
  | `schedule` | Bulutta cron'la çalışan agent'lar; sen uyurken rapor hazır |
  | `keybindings-help` | Kısayolları yeniden bağla, chord'lar dahil |

  </details>

## 🦾 Köle (Free Agent)

Uzun, sıkıcı, çok token yakacak işleri ücretsiz modellere devretmek için. Claude görevi yazar, köle çalışır, Claude sonucu kontrol eder. API anahtarları bu repoda yok, makinede Hermes'in `.env` dosyasında duruyor.

- **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** ⭐ 257k `Ajan`: Dosya okuyup yazan, komut çalıştıran açık kaynak ajan; istediğin modeli takarsın. Web arayüzü de var, tek seferlik terminal modu da. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*
- **[Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)** ⭐ 256k `Ajan`: Nous Research'ün terminal + masaüstü ajanı. `--oneshot` ile görevi alır, cevabı dosyaya yazar, zaman aşımında sıradaki modele düşer. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*
- **[Evren](https://evren-llmapi.ssyz.org.tr)** `Sağlayıcı`: OpenAI uyumlu ücretsiz model kapısı; glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3.8-flash-next. Hızlı (~40 sn). *(Ücretsiz kredi)*
- **[NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com)** `Sağlayıcı`: 80+ modelin ücretsiz API'si; kimi-k2.6, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3, gpt-oss. Kuyruk yüzünden yavaş (~4 dk). *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[FreeLLMAPI](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi)** `Router` ⚠️ *dry-run'da kaldı*: Ücretsiz modelleri tek adreste toplayıp model takılınca sıradakine geçen router. Güvenlik önlemi olarak ilerisine gidilmedi: denendi, kod incelendi, Claude Code'a bağlanmadı, anahtar girilmedi, kaldırıldı. Aynı işi kendi yerel uygulamamızda yazacağız, bu aracı kullanma. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*

  <details>
  <summary>Nasıl çalıştırılır?</summary>

  | Ne | Komut |
  |----|-------|
  | DeepSeek web arayüzü | `deepseek` |
  | Tek seferlik görev (bulunduğun klasörde) | `deepseek "görev"` |
  | Yedekli köle (model düşerse sıradaki) | `calistir.ps1 -Gorev gorevler\is.md -Modeller glm-5.3,dsh:nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6` |
  | Sağlayıcı ayarı | `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (anahtarlar ortam değişkeninden okunur) |

  </details>

**Ekli marketplace'ler:** `claude-plugins-official`, `anthropic-skills`, `ui-ux-pro-max-skill`

> **Not:** Resmi Google sunucusu olan `stitch` dışındaki MCP'ler üçüncü taraf. `npx` ile çalışanlar her açılışta paketi güncellediği için kaynağına güvenmek gerekiyor.

---

## Maliyet Notları

- **Ücretsiz kullanılanlar:** stitch (350 üretim/ay), nanobanana (Flash modeli), context7, markitdown, github, remotion, omniroute, headroom, geo-optimizer, gsc
- **21st** free planında 100 kredi/ay veriyor — birkaç component üretimine denk geliyor, hızlı tükeniyor.
- **meta-ads** Pipeboard'un free planıyla çalışıyor; ilk kullanımda OAuth ile Meta hesabı bağlanıyor.
- **openseo** DataForSEO API'si üzerinden çalışır, istek başına ücret; hosted sürüm %28 ekler. Kullanmadan önce bütçe kararı ver.
- **jev-seo** tarama, kurallar ve raporlar ücretsiz; sayfa yargıları TypeSafe Jev API ile ücretli (sayfa başı ~0,00015$, varsayılan tavan 0,25$). Anahtar yoksa kısmi denetim yapar.
- **gsc** ücretsiz ama Google Cloud'da OAuth (Desktop app) client oluşturmak gerekiyor.
- **nanobanana Pro modeli** (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`) billing gerektirir — görsel başına ücretli. Varsayılan Flash'ta bırakmakta fayda var.
- **Gemini uygulaması aboneliği API'yi kapsamaz.** MCP'ler API anahtarı üzerinden çalışır, abonelik oradan geçmez.
- **fal.ai** ücretli: ücretsiz kota yok, tamamen kullandıkça öde. Kullanmadan önce bütçe kararı ver.

## 🤖 Claude İçi İşlevsel

### Token & Model Yönetimi

- **[OmniRoute](https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute)** ⭐ 75k `MCP` `Skill`: 370+ sağlayıcı, 150+ ücretsiz tier tek endpoint'te. Kota biterse otomatik başka modele geçer, kodlama hiç durmaz. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*

- **`claude-api`** `Yerleşik`: Model ID, fiyat, streaming, tool use. Claude ile uygulama yazarken ezbere değil, doğru bilgiyle.

### Ayar & Otomasyon

- **[Claude Code yerleşik skill'leri](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills)** `Yerleşik`: Kurulum gerektirmez, Claude Code ile gelir. Ayarı, zamanlamayı ve kısayolları sohbetten yönet.

## 🦾 Köle (Free Agent)

Uzun, sıkıcı, çok token yakacak işleri ücretsiz modellere devretmek için. Claude görevi yazar, köle çalışır, Claude sonucu kontrol eder. API anahtarları bu repoda yok, makinede Hermes'in `.env` dosyasında duruyor.

- **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** ⭐ 257k `Ajan`: Dosya okuyup yazan, komut çalıştıran açık kaynak ajan; istediğin modeli takarsın. Web arayüzü de var, tek seferlik terminal modu da. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*
- **[Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)** ⭐ 256k `Ajan`: Nous Research'ün terminal + masaüstü ajanı. `--oneshot` ile görevi alır, cevabı dosyaya yazar, zaman aşımında sıradaki modele düşer. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*
- **[Evren](https://evren-llmapi.ssyz.org.tr)** `Sağlayıcı`: OpenAI uyumlu ücretsiz model kapısı; glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3.8-flash-next. Hızlı (~40 sn). *(Ücretsiz kredi)*
- **[NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com)** `Sağlayıcı`: 80+ modelin ücretsiz API'si; kimi-k2.6, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3, gpt-oss. Kuyruk yüzünden yavaş (~4 dk). *(Ücretsiz)*
- **[FreeLLMAPI](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi)** `Router` ⚠️ *dry-run'da kaldı*: Ücretsiz modelleri tek adreste toplayıp model takılınca sıradakine geçen router. Güvenlik önlemi olarak ilerisine gidilmedi: denendi, kod incelendi, Claude Code'a bağlanmadı, anahtar girilmedi, kaldırıldı. Aynı işi kendi yerel uygulamamızda yazacağız, bu aracı kullanma. *(MIT, ücretsiz)*

  <details>
  <summary>Nasıl çalıştırılır?</summary>

  | Ne | Komut |
  |----|-------|
  | DeepSeek web arayüzü | `deepseek` |
  | Tek seferlik görev (bulunduğun klasörde) | `deepseek "görev"` |
  | Yedekli köle (model düşerse sıradaki) | `calistir.ps1 -Gorev gorevler\is.md -Modeller glm-5.3,dsh:nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6` |
  | Sağlayıcı ayarı | `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (anahtarlar ortam değişkeninden okunur) |

  </details>

**Ekli marketplace'ler:** `claude-plugins-official`, `anthropic-skills`, `ui-ux-pro-max-skill`

> **Not:** Resmi Google sunucusu olan `stitch` dışındaki MCP'ler üçüncü taraf. `npx` ile çalışanlar her açılışta paketi güncellediği için kaynağına güvenmek gerekiyor.

---

## Maliyet Notları

- **Ücretsiz kullanılanlar:** stitch (350 üretim/ay), nanobanana (Flash modeli), context7, markitdown, github, remotion, omniroute, headroom, geo-optimizer, gsc
- **21st** free planında 100 kredi/ay veriyor — birkaç component üretimine denk geliyor, hızlı tükeniyor.
- **meta-ads** Pipeboard'un free planıyla çalışıyor; ilk kullanımda OAuth ile Meta hesabı bağlanıyor.
- **openseo** DataForSEO API'si üzerinden çalışır, istek başına ücret; hosted sürüm %28 ekler. Kullanmadan önce bütçe kararı ver.
- **jev-seo** tarama, kurallar ve raporlar ücretsiz; sayfa yargıları TypeSafe Jev API ile ücretli (sayfa başı ~0,00015$, varsayılan tavan 0,25$). Anahtar yoksa kısmi denetim yapar.
- **gsc** ücretsiz ama Google Cloud'da OAuth (Desktop app) client oluşturmak gerekiyor.
- **nanobanana Pro modeli** (`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`) billing gerektirir — görsel başına ücretli. Varsayılan Flash'ta bırakmakta fayda var.
- **Gemini uygulaması aboneliği API'yi kapsamaz.** MCP'ler API anahtarı üzerinden çalışır, abonelik oradan geçmez.
- **fal.ai** ücretli: ücretsiz kota yok, tamamen kullandıkça öde. Kullanmadan önce bütçe kararı ver.

## What is this An orchestration layer for AI agent teams across Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Cursor/Grok/GitHub/Kiro/Z.AI/Xiaomi/MiniMax/Kimi...(300+ models, 200+ LLM providers, free models no auth) - **Assemble your team** — create agent teams (using 1 prompt) with different roles that work autonomously in parallel - **Sit back and watch** — tasks change status on the kanban board while agents handle everything on their own - **Agents talk to each other** — they communicate, create and manage their own tasks, review, leave comments - **Cross-team communication** — agents can fully communicate across different teams; you can configure or prompt them to collaborate and message each other between teams - **Built-in review workflow** — easily see how agents review each other's tasks to make sure everything went exactly as planned - **Token analytics and budgets** — see input, output, cache, and reasoning usage across teams, agents, tasks, projects, models, runtimes, sessions, commands, and runs. Spot expensive work, track trends and forecasts, set monthly token or estimated-cost budgets, and get alerts at 80% and 100% - **Organizations and global overview** — group teams into departments, squads, or any nested structure. Track every organization on one live map with team and agent status, task progress, dependencies, delegation, and cross-team communication - **Stay in control** — send a direct message to any agent (DM or group chat), drop a comment on a task, or pick a quick action right on the kanban card whenever you want to clarify something or add new work - **Flexible autonomy** — let agents run fully autonomous, or review and approve supported tool actions one by one (you'll get a notification) — configure the level of control that fits your security needs - **Task-specific logs and messages** — clearly see agent/runtime logs (tools), actions and messages in isolation for each individual task, making it easy to trace what happened for any assignment - **Integrated terminal workspace** — run commands in a visual PTY scoped to each team and project, with local shell tabs, persistent history, autocomplete, and terminal settings - **Solo mode** — one-member team: a single agent that creates its own tasks and shows live progress. Saves tokens; can expand to a full team anytime - **Multi-provider orchestration** — start with a free model with no auth, auto-detect available Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode runtimes, or connect Cursor, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI, MiniMax, Kiro and more, using the subscriptions or API keys you already have - **Review changes like in Cursor** — see what code each task changed, then approve, reject, or comment

You see it all on the kanban board The desktop app is the main product. The web version is currently in development. --- ## FAQ
Why not just use Claude Code with pre-configured agents?
We're seeing an interesting trend. First, AI agents started communicating with each other (something Claude and Codex didn't support before). Then we started seeing messenger-style AI assistants like Grok Bot, Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots, where you can create a team (or even multiple teams, as in Grok) and communicate with agents just like in a regular messenger. This is a much more natural and familiar way for people to interact with AI (like with humans). For the general audience, that might be enough. But people often need to build many/large/complex projects, and that's where bigger teams of agents become necessary, each with their own roles and responsibilities. And when you have a lot of teammates, you need a good way to organize and manage them. That's exactly where Agent Teams comes in. You can see everything clearly in a visual interface, understand what's happening across your teams, and easily interact with individual agents. Sure, you can set up something similar with regular Claude, but keeping track of everything without a proper frontend is difficult, and we are targeting precisely this multi-agent use case. For us, it's not just about running multi-agent systems. It's about having full visibility into who's doing what, keeping everything organized, and making it easy to interact with your agents.
Does it read or upload my code?
The app reads local runtime/session data to power the UI, but it does not upload, sync, or send your project or code to Agent Teams servers. There is no Agent Teams cloud backend for storing your code. If you launch an external AI runtime, that runtime communicates directly with its provider under the provider's own terms. Setup checks only verify provider access and capabilities; they do not upload your project to Agent Teams.
Can agents communicate with each other?
Yes. Agents send direct messages, create shared tasks, and leave comments - all coordinated by the app's own orchestration layer.
Is it free?
Yes. The app is free and open source, and you can start with a free model with no auth - no registration, API keys, or credit card. If you want more models, connect the provider access you already have, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode/OpenRouter, Cursor, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI, MiniMax, and Kiro.
Can I review code changes before they're applied?
Yes. Tasks with detected code changes include a full diff view where you can accept, reject, or comment on individual code hunks — similar to Cursor's review flow.
What happens if an agent gets stuck?
Send a direct message to course-correct, or open the teammate status to inspect diagnostics and restart the agent. Agent Teams also has a nudge system: the app can send a short control message when there is a clear reason to wake an agent up, such as after a known rate-limit cooldown, when a teammate has not synced with its current task or review, or when progress appears stalled. Nudges are guarded and rate limited, so they are meant to help the agent continue, not spam it. If an agent needs your input, you'll get a notification and the task will show a distinct badge on the board.
Does it support multiple projects and teams?
Yes. Run multiple teams in one project or across different projects, even simultaneously. To avoid Git conflicts, enable git worktree isolation for selected teammates when launching the team, and use the provisioning prompt for any extra branch or merge rules.
What if the Linux app freezes or shows a blank window over RDP?
Some RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) sessions expose virtual GPU drivers that can break Electron rendering. Launch with `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1` to disable Electron hardware acceleration for that run, for example `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1 pnpm dev` from source or `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1 ./Agent.Teams.AI.AppImage` for AppImage builds.

From a phone, users should be able to see only the high-level tasks that matter and give the lead agent instructions by voice. The lead should route each request to the right project and team, while agents break it down, work in parallel, communicate, review, resolve blockers, and prepare the final result with minimal supervision. Technical subtasks and coordination should remain available as a secondary layer, while the main view surfaces only the decisions, blockers, and outcomes that genuinely need attention. Agents should first try to solve problems together and involve the user only when human input is truly required. This vision is not tied to a specific SDLC or workflow. Users should be free to organize teams however they prefer and continue using their existing plugins, skills, MCP servers, rules, and agent settings. ## Development For feature architecture and implementation guidance: - Canonical standard - [docs/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md](docs/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md) - Repo working instructions - [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) - Feature root guidance - [src/features/README.md](src/features/README.md) - Reference implementation - `src/features/recent-projects` ## Tech stack Electron 40, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Zustand 4. Build from source
**Prerequisites:** Node.js 26.12.1 Current (recommended for source builds) or Node.js 24.22.1 LTS, pnpm 11.22.0 On macOS, official Node.js 24 prebuilt binaries require macOS 13.5+. Node.js 26 does not bundle Corepack; install the pinned pnpm version separately if `pnpm` is unavailable. ```bash git clone https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai.git cd agent-teams-ai pnpm install pnpm dev ``` `pnpm dev` starts the desktop Electron app. Do not start a browser/web dev server for normal development; that path is limited and is not the supported way to run agent teams locally. To run the desktop app against a local orchestrator checkout during development, point it at the source launcher: ```bash CLAUDE_AGENT_TEAMS_ORCHESTRATOR_CLI_PATH=/absolute/path/to/agent_teams_orchestrator/cli-source \ pnpm dev ``` This runs the current orchestrator sources directly through Bun and avoids rebuilding the complete runtime bundle on every app start. Do not use `CLAUDE_DEV_RUNTIME_ROOT` for the normal source development loop: that override runs `bun run build:dev` before Electron starts and can make the app appear stuck at `bun run ./scripts/build.ts --dev`. Use it only when intentionally validating the generated development bundle. Use `pnpm dev:mcp` for automated interactive or visual UI verification. It exposes the current Electron renderer through the local Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint on `127.0.0.1:9222`, avoiding window-selection ambiguity when packaged or other Electron apps are also open. The desktop app auto-discovers Claude Code projects from `~/.claude/`. ### Terminal Platform integration Fresh clones install Terminal Platform SDK packages from `vendor/terminal-platform`, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` does not require a sibling `../terminal-platform` checkout. Those artifacts are pinned in `vendor/terminal-platform/manifest.json` and can be refreshed from a local Terminal Platform checkout with: ```bash CLAUDE_TERMINAL_PLATFORM_ROOT=/path/to/terminal-platform pnpm terminal-platform:pack ``` For local Terminal Platform development, build Terminal Platform first, then run this app with the same environment variable: ```bash CLAUDE_TERMINAL_PLATFORM_ROOT=/path/to/terminal-platform pnpm dev:mcp ``` When the variable is set, the Electron build aliases Terminal Platform SDK imports to that local checkout and the terminal runtime loads `terminal-platform-node` from the local native artifact. ### Debug teammate runtimes Development launches use the app-managed process backend for teammates by default. To inspect teammates in `tmux` panes while debugging, start the desktop app with: ```bash CLAUDE_TEAM_TEAMMATE_MODE=tmux pnpm dev ``` The same override is available per launch from custom CLI args with `--teammate-mode tmux`. Use this as an operator/debug mode; the default process backend provides stronger app-owned lifecycle, diagnostics, and cleanup for normal team launches. ### Build for distribution ```bash pnpm dist:mac:arm64 # macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg) pnpm dist:mac:x64 # macOS Intel (.dmg) pnpm dist:win # Windows (.exe) pnpm dist:linux # Linux (AppImage/.deb/.rpm/.pacman) pnpm dist # Current platform ``` Distribution scripts run the production build and stage the bundled multimodel runtime from `runtime.lock.json` before packaging. Use `pnpm clean:runtime` to remove staged runtime files after local packaging. ### Scripts | Command | Description | | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `pnpm dev` | Desktop app development with hot reload | | `pnpm dev:mcp` | Desktop app development with hot reload and local CDP debugging on port 9222 | | `pnpm build` | Production build | | `pnpm typecheck` | TypeScript type checking | | `pnpm lint` | Lint (no auto-fix) | | `pnpm lint:fix` | Lint and auto-fix | | `pnpm format` | Format code with Prettier | | `pnpm test` | Run all tests | | `pnpm test:watch` | Watch mode | | `pnpm test:coverage` | Coverage report | | `pnpm test:coverage:critical` | Critical path coverage | | `pnpm check` | Full quality gate (types + lint + test + build) | | `pnpm fix` | Lint fix + format | | `pnpm quality` | Full check + format check + knip |

### [Boss, watch the video](https://agentteams.live/)

       

Free cross-platform desktop app for AI agent teams. Start with a free model with no auth - no signup, API key, or card - or connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI, MiniMax, Kiro, and many more. For coding and broader project work. Check also: - [universal-agent-plugins](https://universal-agent-plugins.com) - Multi-agent CLI to install, update, repair, and remove Agent Plugins 1.0 and Agent Skills across Codex/ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, Qoder, Pi, OpenCode, and more. 1,500+ plugins. SDK for universal plugins (hooks, detect, install/manage) - [review-router-ai](https://github.com/777genius/review-router-ai) - Fast, cost-effective, secure code review that runs inside your CI/CD using your Claude/Codex/other subscription accounts (pool)/API. Free/self-hosted deployment. Ready github integration. Built using OpenCodeReview. Claude/Codex/OpenRouter/Grok/Kimi/Glm/MiniMax/MiMo... - [agent-notifications](https://agent-notifications.com) - 🔔 Cross-platform smart notifications for Claude/Codex/OpenCode/Cursor/Gemini/Qoder/Pi. Desktop alerts, sounds, click-to-focus, and webhooks. macOS, Linux, and Windows.

### Screenshots ([watch on our site](https://agentteams.live/#screenshots)):

## Installation No prerequisites - the app can detect installed Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode runtimes. You can also connect Cursor, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI, MiniMax, and Kiro from the UI.

--- ## Quick start 1. **Download** the app for your platform (see [Installation](#installation)) 2. **Launch the desktop app** - start with the free model with no auth, or let the setup wizard detect runtimes and guide provider authentication 3. **Create a team** — Pick a project, define roles, write a provisioning prompt 4. **Watch** — Agents spawn, create tasks, and work. You see it all on the kanban board The desktop app is the main product. The web version is currently in development. --- ## FAQ
Why not just use Claude Code with pre-configured agents?
We're seeing an interesting trend. First, AI agents started communicating with each other (something Claude and Codex didn't support before). Then we started seeing messenger-style AI assistants like Grok Bot, Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots, where you can create a team (or even multiple teams, as in Grok) and communicate with agents just like in a regular messenger. This is a much more natural and familiar way for people to interact with AI (like with humans). For the general audience, that might be enough. But people often need to build many/large/complex projects, and that's where bigger teams of agents become necessary, each with their own roles and responsibilities. And when you have a lot of teammates, you need a good way to organize and manage them. That's exactly where Agent Teams comes in. You can see everything clearly in a visual interface, understand what's happening across your teams, and easily interact with individual agents. Sure, you can set up something similar with regular Claude, but keeping track of everything without a proper frontend is difficult, and we are targeting precisely this multi-agent use case. For us, it's not just about running multi-agent systems. It's about having full visibility into who's doing what, keeping everything organized, and making it easy to interact with your agents.
Does it read or upload my code?
The app reads local runtime/session data to power the UI, but it does not upload, sync, or send your project or code to Agent Teams servers. There is no Agent Teams cloud backend for storing your code. If you launch an external AI runtime, that runtime communicates directly with its provider under the provider's own terms. Setup checks only verify provider access and capabilities; they do not upload your project to Agent Teams.
Can agents communicate with each other?
Yes. Agents send direct messages, create shared tasks, and leave comments - all coordinated by the app's own orchestration layer.
Is it free?
Yes. The app is free and open source, and you can start with a free model with no auth - no registration, API keys, or credit card. If you want more models, connect the provider access you already have, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode/OpenRouter, Cursor, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Z.AI, MiniMax, and Kiro.
Can I review code changes before they're applied?
Yes. Tasks with detected code changes include a full diff view where you can accept, reject, or comment on individual code hunks — similar to Cursor's review flow.
What happens if an agent gets stuck?
Send a direct message to course-correct, or open the teammate status to inspect diagnostics and restart the agent. Agent Teams also has a nudge system: the app can send a short control message when there is a clear reason to wake an agent up, such as after a known rate-limit cooldown, when a teammate has not synced with its current task or review, or when progress appears stalled. Nudges are guarded and rate limited, so they are meant to help the agent continue, not spam it. If an agent needs your input, you'll get a notification and the task will show a distinct badge on the board.
Does it support multiple projects and teams?
Yes. Run multiple teams in one project or across different projects, even simultaneously. To avoid Git conflicts, enable git worktree isolation for selected teammates when launching the team, and use the provisioning prompt for any extra branch or merge rules.
What if the Linux app freezes or shows a blank window over RDP?
Some RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) sessions expose virtual GPU drivers that can break Electron rendering. Launch with `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1` to disable Electron hardware acceleration for that run, for example `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1 pnpm dev` from source or `AGENT_TEAMS_DISABLE_GPU=1 ./Agent.Teams.AI.AppImage` for AppImage builds.
--- ## Roadmap (new) - [ ] Launching 24/7 autonomous teams in the cloud (in progress) - [ ] Automatic account switching (in progress) - [ ] Navigating very complex long tasks without losing context (in progress) - [x] Multiple AI runtimes and provider-backed coding agents (more in progress) - [ ] A secure universal plugin system regardless of the type of agents ([in progress](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins)) - [ ] Efficiency and controllability under load with 50-100+ agents in parallel (in progress) ## Vision Agent Teams AI is moving toward a simple interface for highly autonomous work. From a phone, users should be able to see only the high-level tasks that matter and give the lead agent instructions by voice. The lead should route each request to the right project and team, while agents break it down, work in parallel, communicate, review, resolve blockers, and prepare the final result with minimal supervision. Technical subtasks and coordination should remain available as a secondary layer, while the main view surfaces only the decisions, blockers, and outcomes that genuinely need attention. Agents should first try to solve problems together and involve the user only when human input is truly required. This vision is not tied to a specific SDLC or workflow. Users should be free to organize teams however they prefer and continue using their existing plugins, skills, MCP servers, rules, and agent settings. ## Development For feature architecture and implementation guidance: - Canonical standard - [docs/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md](docs/FEATURE_ARCHITECTURE_STANDARD.md) - Repo working instructions - [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) - Feature root guidance - [src/features/README.md](src/features/README.md) - Reference implementation - `src/features/recent-projects` ## Tech stack Electron 40, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Zustand 4. The desktop app reads local project, app, and runtime/session data. Claude Code data under `~/.claude/` is one supported local source, while some runtime modes may also use provider or startup capability services when required.
Build from source
**Prerequisites:** Node.js 26.12.1 Current (recommended for source builds) or Node.js 24.22.1 LTS, pnpm 11.22.0 On macOS, official Node.js 24 prebuilt binaries require macOS 13.5+. Node.js 26 does not bundle Corepack; install the pinned pnpm version separately if `pnpm` is unavailable. ```bash git clone https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai.git cd agent-teams-ai pnpm install pnpm dev ``` `pnpm dev` starts the desktop Electron app. Do not start a browser/web dev server for normal development; that path is limited and is not the supported way to run agent teams locally. To run the desktop app against a local orchestrator checkout during development, point it at the source launcher: ```bash CLAUDE_AGENT_TEAMS_ORCHESTRATOR_CLI_PATH=/absolute/path/to/agent_teams_orchestrator/cli-source \ pnpm dev ``` This runs the current orchestrator sources directly through Bun and avoids rebuilding the complete runtime bundle on every app start. Do not use `CLAUDE_DEV_RUNTIME_ROOT` for the normal source development loop: that override runs `bun run build:dev` before Electron starts and can make the app appear stuck at `bun run ./scripts/build.ts --dev`. Use it only when intentionally validating the generated development bundle. Use `pnpm dev:mcp` for automated interactive or visual UI verification. It exposes the current Electron renderer through the local Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint on `127.0.0.1:9222`, avoiding window-selection ambiguity when packaged or other Electron apps are also open. The desktop app auto-discovers Claude Code projects from `~/.claude/`. ### Terminal Platform integration Fresh clones install Terminal Platform SDK packages from `vendor/terminal-platform`, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` does not require a sibling `../terminal-platform` checkout. Those artifacts are pinned in `vendor/terminal-platform/manifest.json` and can be refreshed from a local Terminal Platform checkout with: ```bash CLAUDE_TERMINAL_PLATFORM_ROOT=/path/to/terminal-platform pnpm terminal-platform:pack ``` For local Terminal Platform development, build Terminal Platform first, then run this app with the same environment variable: ```bash CLAUDE_TERMINAL_PLATFORM_ROOT=/path/to/terminal-platform pnpm dev:mcp ``` When the variable is set, the Electron build aliases Terminal Platform SDK imports to that local checkout and the terminal runtime loads `terminal-platform-node` from the local native artifact. ### Debug teammate runtimes Development launches use the app-managed process backend for teammates by default. To inspect teammates in `tmux` panes while debugging, start the desktop app with: ```bash CLAUDE_TEAM_TEAMMATE_MODE=tmux pnpm dev ``` The same override is available per launch from custom CLI args with `--teammate-mode tmux`. Use this as an operator/debug mode; the default process backend provides stronger app-owned lifecycle, diagnostics, and cleanup for normal team launches. ### Build for distribution ```bash pnpm dist:mac:arm64 # macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg) pnpm dist:mac:x64 # macOS Intel (.dmg) pnpm dist:win # Windows (.exe) pnpm dist:linux # Linux (AppImage/.deb/.rpm/.pacman) pnpm dist # Current platform ``` Distribution scripts run the production build and stage the bundled multimodel runtime from `runtime.lock.json` before packaging. Use `pnpm clean:runtime` to remove staged runtime files after local packaging. ### Scripts | Command | Description | | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `pnpm dev` | Desktop app development with hot reload | | `pnpm dev:mcp` | Desktop app development with hot reload and local CDP debugging on port 9222 | | `pnpm build` | Production build | | `pnpm typecheck` | TypeScript type checking | | `pnpm lint` | Lint (no auto-fix) | | `pnpm lint:fix` | Lint and auto-fix | | `pnpm format` | Format code with Prettier | | `pnpm test` | Run all tests | | `pnpm test:watch` | Watch mode | | `pnpm test:coverage` | Coverage report | | `pnpm test:coverage:critical` | Critical path coverage | | `pnpm check` | Full quality gate (types + lint + test + build) | | `pnpm fix` | Lint fix + format | | `pnpm quality` | Full check + format check + knip |

repository.name: universal-agent-plugins
repository.readme:
[![Required](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/777genius/universal-agent-plugins) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/universal-agent-plugins?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/universal-agent-plugins) [![Agent Plugins 1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent%20Plugins-1.0.0-7257FF)](https://agent-plugins.org/specification) [![Agent Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent%20Skills-standard-7257FF)](https://agentskills.io/specification) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [Documentation](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/) · [Browse plugins](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/plugins/) · [Build a plugin](#build-plugins)

Install and manage plugins and Skills across your AI agents with one CLI. Share `uap.toml` (package list) and `uap.lock` (exact versions) to restore your setup on another computer or with your team. **More than a one-time installer:** UAP combines a [searchable plugin directory](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/plugins/), independent [Agent Skills](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/agent-skills/), native multi-agent installation, managed repair/removal, portable dependency locks, and [Go/TypeScript SDKs](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/sdk/). Review [product capabilities and release boundaries](docs/PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES.md) for evidence and limitations.

## Contents - [Use plugins](#use-plugins) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Install the CLI](#install-the-cli) - [What the CLI does](#what-the-cli-does) - [More capabilities](#more-capabilities) - [Install for one project](#install-for-one-project) - [Restore your plugin setup](#restore-your-plugin-setup) - [Install from other sources](#install-from-other-sources) - [Supported clients](#supported-clients) - [More commands](#more-commands) - [Find and verify plugins](#find-and-verify-plugins) - [Safe updates and removal](#safe-updates-and-removal) - [SDKs and integrations](#sdks-and-integrations) - [Build plugins](#build-plugins) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [License](#license) **Build plugins:** [authoring guide](website/source/en/build/index.md) · [package layout](website/source/en/build/layout.md) · [validate package](website/source/en/build/checks.md). Source-built `agentplugins author` supports scaffolding and diagnostics, but **native CLI 0.1.110 does not ship it yet**. Standard-first bundle export and marketplace publication are not part of the current `author` command. ## Use plugins ### Quick start Install a [supported agent](#supported-clients) first. Then, with Node.js 22+, add Context7: ```bash npx universal-agent-plugins add context7 ``` Choose from the detected agents, follow any sign-in or approval steps, then start a new session. This installs for your user account. To keep plugins in one repository, use [project installation](#install-for-one-project). **Choose your agents** **Review the installation plan — Playwright example** **Follow installation progress — Playwright example** ### Install the CLI Choose one method. Only npm requires Node.js; Homebrew and the native scripts do not. **macOS and Linux — Homebrew:** ```bash brew install 777genius/agentplugins/agentplugins agentplugins add context7 ``` **macOS and Linux — native installer:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/main/install.sh | sh -s -- add context7 ``` **Windows — PowerShell:** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/main/install.ps1 | iex & "$HOME\.local\bin\agentplugins.exe" add context7 ``` **npm — Node.js 22+:** ```bash npm install -g universal-agent-plugins agentplugins add context7 ``` The native scripts verify the download's checksum and version, then install to `$HOME/.local/bin`. Add that directory to `PATH` to use `agentplugins` by name. Plugins may need additional runtimes; see [installation help](docs/NATIVE_INSTALL.md). For the latest stable native installer, see [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/releases/latest). Check `agentplugins version`: npm and Homebrew can lag behind native releases. Code in `main` may not be released yet. ## What the CLI does - Installs supported package components in one or more agents. - Records exact versions for repeatable installs. - Updates, repairs, and removes managed files without overwriting unrelated content. - Reports any remaining approval, sign-in, or reload steps. ## More capabilities For AI-agent / headless installation, see the [agent-first CLI guide](docs/AGENT_CLI.md): explicit targets and scope, read-only Skills discovery, JSON results, and lifecycle verification. New source-only commands are labelled separately from released CLI behavior. | Need | How UAP helps | | --- | --- | | Multiple agents | `add --target codex,claude` with separate outcomes and any remaining activation steps. | | Standalone Skills | `skills add` with a browser picker or explicit `--skill` selections; see [Skills installation](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/use/install.html#install-agent-skills). | | Sources outside the registry | Reviewed local package directories, Git/SSH sources and complete ZIP/TAR archives; see [source formats](docs/DIRECT_PACKAGE_SOURCES.md). | | Team/project reproducibility | Commit `uap.toml` and `uap.lock`, then run `install --locked --scope project`; see [dependency environments](docs/UAP_DEPENDENCIES.md). | | Package creation and checks | [Authoring guide](website/source/en/build/index.md) for source-build templates, validation and compatibility checks (not in 0.1.110 native CLI). | | Development-only roots | `[dev-dependencies]` in `uap.toml` with explicit targets, omitted from consumers; requires a release containing this feature. | | Moving a user setup | `deps export` and `deps import --install`; no credentials or live data are exported. | | Maintenance | `doctor`, `outdated`, `update --dry-run`, `repair --dry-run`, explicit remove and scope flags. | | Application integration | [Go Installer](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/sdk/go-installer.html) or [TypeScript Management SDK](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/sdk/typescript-management.html). | | Typed agent callbacks | [Go Hooks SDK](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/sdk/go-hooks.html), with event- and release-specific support. | File preparation, native activation, MCP execution and authentication are separate checkpoints. Check each target's result after a multi-agent operation. ## Install for one project Use `--scope project` (CLI 0.1.93+) to install in one repository without changing your user setup. **Signed Directory short names** Merged installer PR #725 supports explicit Project placement for an eligible signed package and its required dependencies, using each selected client's real Project capabilities. Historical User runtime evidence is not Project activation evidence. In the published stable CLI: ```sh cd /path/to/project agentplugins add context7 --target codex --scope project --dry-run ``` Review the plan before omitting `--dry-run`. Unsupported clients or mandatory components fail closed; there is no implicit User fallback. **Alternative: exact Git source.** For reproducibility, copy a compatible, commit-pinned Git source from the [catalog](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/plugins/) and replace the placeholders: ```sh cd /path/to/project agentplugins add github:OWNER/REPOSITORY@FULL_COMMIT_SHA//PACKAGE_PATH \ --scope project --target codex ``` Use a full 40-character commit SHA; omit `//PACKAGE_PATH` for a root package. Direct Git is an alternative to a signed Directory alias. Neither route bypasses native client trust or complete dependency authorization. **Share and restore** Commit the generated `uap.toml` and `uap.lock`; add `.uap/` to `.gitignore`. In another checkout, install UAP and the required agents, then run from the project root: ```sh agentplugins install --locked --scope project ``` `--locked` requires a lockfile matching the manifest and restores its exact versions. **Add standalone Skills** ```sh agentplugins skills add owner/repository --ui --scope project ``` Use a real Skills repository; `--ui` opens a browser picker. Outside the project, add `--project-root /path/to/project`. Always include `--scope project` with add, update, repair, and remove. Otherwise, they use your user setup—even inside the project. ChatGPT has no native project installation. See the [project guide](docs/PROJECT_INSTALLATION.md) for maintenance and the [project support table](docs/PROJECT_CLIENT_SUPPORT.md) for each agent's limits. ## Restore your plugin setup Export your saved user-wide setup to an empty folder: ```sh agentplugins deps export /path/to/transfer ``` Copy `uap.toml` and `uap.lock` to the new computer, install UAP and the required agents, then import from the folder containing those files: ```sh agentplugins deps import /path/to/transfer --install ``` Only `uap.toml` and `uap.lock` travel. These commands use your user setup, not a project's. Sign-ins, secrets, agent settings, and plugin data need separate setup or backup. Packages must remain available from their sources or the destination cache; this is not an offline backup. Check supported agents with `agentplugins deps status`. [Dependency guide](docs/UAP_DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Import and recovery](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/use/manage.html#restore-on-another-machine) ## Install from other sources Install an Agent Plugins 1.0 package from a local folder, Git (HTTPS or SSH), or a ZIP/TAR/TAR.GZ archive (local or HTTPS). No catalog entry is required. Only `plugin.json` is supported as the package manifest: | File or folder | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `plugin.json` | Required package manifest | | `skills/` | Optional reusable instructions | | `mcp.json` | Optional MCP servers | | `hooks/` | Optional client-specific extensions | Skills are instructions; MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers connect agents to tools. Both work across supported clients; hooks depend on the client. See [source formats and credentials](docs/DIRECT_PACKAGE_SOURCES.md). Standalone `SKILL.md` files use `agentplugins skills add`, not `agentplugins add`. It accepts GitHub repositories and HTTPS publishers with a Skills index. Publisher installs need an exact `--skill` name; see the [Skills guide](docs/AGENT_SKILLS_INSTALLER.md). ## Supported clients **User** installs into your agent profile; **Project** installs into one selected workspace. Agents may still ask you to trust the project, sign in, or restart. | Agent | User scope | Project scope | Setup | What you do after installing | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Claude Code** | Plugins, Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Trust the workspace and reload Claude Code if prompted. | | **Codex CLI** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Open a new session; approve project MCP access if prompted. | | **OpenCode** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Start a new session and review effective project settings. | | **Cursor** | Plugins, Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Prepared | Reload Cursor; enable plugins or MCP servers if requested. | | **GitHub Copilot CLI** | Plugins, Skills, MCP | Plugins, Skills, MCP (prepared) | Automatic | Restart Copilot CLI if requested. | | **Gemini CLI** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Reload Gemini CLI and approve tool access if prompted. | | **Qoder** | Plugins, Skills, MCP, hooks | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Restart Qoder and review MCP permissions. | | **Pi** | Extensions, Skills, MCP | Extensions, Skills, MCP | Automatic | Trust the project and reload Pi resources. | | **Windsurf / Devin** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Open or restart Devin in the selected project; review access. | | **Kimi Code** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Automatic | Run /reload or /new and review MCP permissions. | | **Cline** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP (prepared) | Automatic | Select the project MCP settings path and reload Cline. | | **Kiro** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP | Guided | The CLI configures supported Skills and MCP automatically; sign in, approve access, and restart if prompted. | | **Grok Build** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP (prepared) | Automatic | Open the selected project in Grok, review trust, and follow any remaining enablement or reload steps; verify Skills and MCP. | | **Hermes Agent** | Skills, MCP | Skills, MCP (prepared) | Automatic | Restart Hermes and trust the project; Project MCP requires a verified standalone Hermes bundle and an explicitly confirmed UAP project session. | | **Google Antigravity** | Plugins, Skills, MCP | Plugins, Skills, MCP | Prepared | Open or reload Antigravity; review trust and verify the prepared plugin is discovered and enabled in the selected scope. | | **ChatGPT** | Desktop local plugins; Web connected apps | Not supported | Guided | Desktop: local install via Codex CLI; Web: connect or install in ChatGPT. | **Setup terms:** Automatic = UAP installs supported components; Guided = follow client prompts; Prepared = files are ready but need activation; Manual = complete setup in the app. After confirmation, UAP completes supported native setup and reports remaining trust, sign-in or reload steps. This matrix describes the released installer capabilities of [native CLI 0.1.115](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/releases/tag/agentplugins-v0.1.115) for every agent above; signed Directory packages still need an eligible target. Installation does not prove native runtime activation or vendor authentication. See the [compatibility reference](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/reference/client-compatibility.html) for tested versions, platforms, and setup steps.
Client-specific setup and limits Since CLI 0.1.102, the published CLI supports Pi [native extensions](docs/PI_NATIVE_EXTENSION_CONTRACT.md), Skills and stdio/Streamable HTTP MCP in user and eligible project scope. Each signed Directory release still needs an explicit Pi target; direct pinned Git sources use a separate CLI-validated installation path. For scoped trust, activation and native E2E limits, see the [project compatibility matrix](docs/PROJECT_CLIENT_SUPPORT.md). Hermes supports User Skills and stdio/Streamable HTTP MCP, plus Project Skills at the selected Git root. Project MCP is prepared only with a verified standalone Hermes host bundle and an explicitly confirmed UAP project session; ordinary startup does not select it. A Hermes host installed from source supports User MCP or Project Skills only; this does not restrict plugin Git sources. Antigravity prepares owned User/Project native plugins with Skills and supported MCP; verify discovery, trust and enablement in the IDE. Preparation does not prove IDE activation. For both clients, ordinary portable commands project to Skills; explicit-only commands are withheld because these hosts cannot enforce explicit invocation. Grok Build, Kimi Code, and Qoder support stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP in user scope. Grok Project plugin enablement is opt-in on Linux with Grok 1.0.70 and preserves an existing disabled preference. Devin User and Project delivery require 3000.11.205 or 3000.12.57. For GitHub Copilot CLI stable 1.0.81 or later, or prerelease 1.0.81-N with N of 8 or higher, UAP registers a compatible Agent Plugins 1.0 package as a native project plugin in `.github/copilot/settings.local.json`. It keeps loose project Skills and MCP for new installs on an older or unobserved version, packages with commands, an app, invalid components, bundled stdio executables or `PLUGIN_DATA` launchers, and existing loose installations. UAP reports the registration as Prepared; start a new Copilot CLI session to load it. Cline Project MCP requires an explicitly selected managed session/settings path. Qoder also preserves native hooks, commands, and bundled binaries. See [portable commands](docs/UAP_COMMANDS.md) for command delivery and limits. For guided Context7 setup in ChatGPT and Kiro: ```bash npx universal-agent-plugins add context7 --target chatgptweb,kiro --no-save ``` ChatGPT requires Developer Mode and custom apps. You must install the prepared package yourself and select it in a new chat. This command uses `--no-save` because ChatGPT setup cannot be saved as a portable dependency. To save plugins for other agents, install those separately without `--no-save`. See the [Context7 setup guide](docs/CONTEXT7_CHATGPT_KIRO_E2E.md). Codex supports stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP, but excludes SSE components; see [transport details](docs/CODEX_TRANSPORT_EVIDENCE.md).
## More commands Omit `--target` to choose agents interactively; name them explicitly in scripts. ```bash # Find and inspect packages agentplugins search docs agentplugins info context7 # Install in specific agents agentplugins add context7 --target codex,claude # Maintain an installed plugin agentplugins update context7 --target codex,claude agentplugins repair context7 --target codex,claude agentplugins remove context7 --target codex,claude agentplugins outdated --all agentplugins update --all agentplugins doctor # Validate and try a local package agentplugins validate ./my-plugin agentplugins add ./my-plugin ``` Local folder installs are not saved as portable dependencies. Use a pinned Git or HTTPS archive source to restore the package on another computer. ## Find and verify plugins [Browse the catalog](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/plugins/) or run `agentplugins search`. Reviewed and unreviewed results are labelled separately. Discovery is not an endorsement; packages are checked again before installation. To list a package, see [registry contributions](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins-registry/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Safe updates and removal Use `--dry-run` to preview changes without modifying managed client files. Security checks may still download scanners or metadata. No install telemetry is sent. UAP checks packages, clients, and file ownership before making changes. It preserves unrelated content and external edits, reports conflicts, and rolls back failures only where safe. Check every agent's result after a multi-agent operation: some may succeed while others need attention. Repair restores managed files. Sign-in and testing inside the agent remain separate. [Removal and retained data](docs/REMOVAL_SAFETY.md) · [Steps requiring your approval](docs/INSTALLER_AUTOMATION_PRINCIPLE.md) UAP is an independent community project, unaffiliated with OpenAI, Agent Plugins, or the client vendors. ## SDKs and integrations For Go Hooks, host detection, installation, and TypeScript management, see the [SDK integration guides](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/sdk/).
Agent Notifications
Desktop notifications, sounds, and click-to-focus for AI coding agents.
Use the [Go SDK](sdk/README.md) for typed agent hooks and [Go installer components](install/integrationctl/agentplugins/installer/README.md) to embed plugin management in your app. The [TypeScript SDK](sdks/typescript/README.md), `universal-agent-plugins-management-sdk`, calls the CLI's local management API. Pin compatible SDK and CLI versions separately; see the [management guide](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/use/manage.html#local-management-api). ## Build plugins Create a package directory with root `plugin.json`, with optional `skills/` and `mcp.json`. `plugin.json` is the only supported authoring manifest. Validate and install it with the [local-package commands](#more-commands). The [Build guide](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/build/) covers Skills and MCP packages; start with the [Use / Build quickstart](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/guide/quickstart.html).
Authoring commands (qualified authoring or source build required) The current npm and native installer releases do not include `agentplugins author`. In qualified authoring builds, `agentplugins author` is the public authoring entrypoint. For example: ```bash agentplugins author init ./my-plugin --template skill --name my-plugin agentplugins author validate ./my-plugin agentplugins author inspect ./my-plugin agentplugins author test ./my-plugin ``` In qualified/source builds, MCP execution is available through `author test` and `author dev`. Dependency bootstrap apply currently requires Linux; dry-run planning can be used on other platforms. Local stdio development requires Linux, successful process-containment and bubblewrap preflights, and a supported system Node path. See the [stdio guide](https://universal-agent-plugins.com/docs/en/build/mcp-stdio.html). Client projection, export/bundle, and publication are not exposed by the current authoring CLI. Native installer [releases](https://github.com/777genius/universal-agent-plugins/releases) use `agentplugins-v*` tags; they do not include these authoring commands.
## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development workflow. Run: ```bash go test ./... make vet ``` [Security policy](SECURITY.md) · [Support boundary](docs/SUPPORT.md) · [Client E2E evidence](docs/AGENTPLUGINS_CLIENT_E2E.md) ## License [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). sampled_files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: Required

on:
  # The refactor base branch is listed by name, not as refactor/**: the part
  # branches stacked on it are gated by core-fast.yml, and a glob would run this
  # 12-17 minute lane again on every push to every part, which is the double
  # spend the plan set out to avoid. The full lane belongs after a part merges
  # into the base branch.
  push:
    branches: [main, master, refactor/installer-core-clean-architecture]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches: [main, master]

# Release evidence: only a newer push to the same pull request supersedes a
# run. Each push gets a group of its own, so a later merge neither cancels nor
# replaces the release checks of an earlier merge commit. Release validation
# also accepts the merged PR head's checks.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  # Pull requests only: the shared classifier lets lint and the Management SDK
  # qualification skip when none of their inputs changed. `test` never waits
  # for it and runs on every ready pull request, because repotests also read
  # README.md, docs/, website/, landing/ and workflow files. Pushes and an
  # unavailable or oversized classification run every job.
  changes:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pr-changes.yml

  # Separate job rather than a step in `test`: `test` is the 9-27 min critical
  # path, while the three lint matrix legs finish in a few minutes in parallel.
  lint:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.lint != 'false') }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/lint.yml
    with:
      # pull_request → origin/<base>; push → origin/main so architecture
      # pushes are scored the same way as the WIP PR into main.
      lint-base: origin/${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}

  # One qualification definition shared with the Management SDK release.
  management-sdk:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.event.pull_request.draft == false && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || needs.changes.outputs.management_sdk != 'false'))) }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/management-sdk.yml

  # Same hermetic staged-package test the release prepare step runs, in parallel with `test`.
  staged-hermetic:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false }}
    runs-on: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci:github-hosted') && 'ubuntu-latest' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository && 'ubuntu-latest' || vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "22.21.1"
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Run hermetic staged-package test
        working-directory: npm/agentplugins
        run: node --test --test-name-pattern="staged package tests are hermetic" test/stage-release.test.js

  test:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false }}
    runs-on: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci:github-hosted') && 'ubuntu-latest' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository && 'ubuntu-latest' || vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Frozen exporter tests need the audited factory fixture independently
      # of the current CLI source. Fetch exact snapshots, not full history.
      - name: Fetch audited documentation test fixtures
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 0506dd888029ad69d07dd5263669fb53766dbdf9
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin c77c9975eb41d81bcca178b2974ecc6cd1eb1d22
          git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 66710680c22cc0cf7cc926e1438bb9d647eff1a2

      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.26.11"
          cache: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "22.21.1"
          package-manager-cache: false

      # The hermetic staged-package test reruns the whole npm suite, so it runs in the
      # staged-hermetic job below and not on this critical path.
      - name: Run required lane
        env:
          AGENTPLUGINS_SKIP_STAGED_HERMETIC: "1"
        run: make test-required

      - name: Plugin Manifest Workflow
        run: make test-plugin-manifest-workflow

      - name: Check generated artifacts
        run: make generated-check

      - name: Run vet (all workspace modules)
        run: make vet

      # The proposal discussed in agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec#81 is not a
      # normative part of the specification. Pinning the exact revision keeps
      # this interoperability contract reproducible until a new revision is
      # reviewed deliberately.
      - name: Check out pinned Agent Plugins conformance corpus
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Booyaka101/agent-plugins-conformance-kit
          ref: 4d163c6281a9b4929f482f387efe340b4dc175a1
          path: .ci/agent-plugins-conformance-kit
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build pinned conformance corpus
        working-directory: .ci/agent-plugins-conformance-kit
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build

      - name: Run Agent Plugins loader conformance
        run: |
          go build -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/agentplugins-conformance-adapter" ./cli/cmd/agentplugins-conformance-adapter
          node .ci/agent-plugins-conformance-kit/dist/cli.js verify
          node .ci/agent-plugins-conformance-kit/dist/cli.js run \
            --adapter "$RUNNER_TEMP/agentplugins-conformance-adapter" \
            --strict-reporting \
            --quiet \
            --json "$RUNNER_TEMP/agentplugins-conformance.json"
