| Slide   | Pages, text, shapes, images, tables, charts, SVG layouts, and transitions                     | Structure inspection, layout lint, screenshots, and PDF printing    | `.ppt` `.pptx`                       | `.pptx`               |
| Base    | Tables, fields, records, views, formulas, filters, sorting, and grouping                      | Structured data checks and workbench screenshots                    | `.xls` `.xlsx` `.xlsm` `.csv` `.tsv` | `.xlsx` `.csv` `.tsv` |
| Board   | Shapes, text, connectors, images, native charts, and routing                                  | Model/rendered layout lint, screenshots, and PDF printing           | —                                    | —                     |

Every content type supports isolated draft editing, review, revision, merge, and discard. Board file import and export are not currently supported.

## How it works

1. The discovery Skill checks that Univer CLI is installed, current, and ready.
2. The agent loads the core Skill and the matching Sheet, Doc, Slide, Base, or Board Skill from the installed CLI.
3. The agent imports or creates a `.univer` file and opens an isolated draft Worktree.
4. It inspects the target Unit, makes the requested changes, and reads the stored model back.
5. It captures screenshots or runs layout lint when appearance matters.

When installed `univer lint --help` exposes `--plan`, a rendered Board lint can return one read-only
layout plan per page. Use `graph`, `routes`, `ports`, `labels`, or `text`. The Board skill explains
how to inspect `analyses[].plan`, apply a ready plan in the same draft, and capture the result.

6. It marks the Worktree `ready` and returns a local Viewer URL.
7. The user reviews the result and explicitly chooses merge, reopen, or discard.

The review Header shows the selected document name, truncates long names, and wraps controls as space narrows.

Inside a Worktree, the Viewer offers read-only **View** and **Compare** modes for Sheet, Doc, Slide,
Base, and Board Units. Diff compares the current Worktree with a pinned Trunk state by default; the
left side can instead be another active Worktree that contains changes for the selected product type.
Both sides are materialized through their pinned heads before comparison, and a stale comparison is
refreshed explicitly. Slide and Base change lists follow the selected page or table; selecting a
change focuses its target in both read-only panes.

Sheet Compare offers independent **Content / Formatting** filters and a **Show formulas** switch
for both grids. Content uses plain display copies without original cell, rich-text, table-theme or
conditional formatting, retaining diff colors and row/column geometry; Formatting keeps the original
styles. Formula display resolves shared formulas without changing stored values or results;
worksheet/workbook scope is selected in the change-tree header.

Univer Pro History owns semantic diff computation. The application only maps its returned changes,
inline segments, and native alignment to localized navigation, read-only coloring, and linked viewports.

The pinned result is also available through the Server API as a versioned, UI-independent Agent
context. CLI clients and agents can page or filter normalized insert/delete/update items by entity
type, stable parent ID, or search text;
each item carries stable paths and side-specific navigation targets for Sheet, Doc, Slide, Base, and
Board. Normalized leaf changes expose semantic property paths, typed before/after values, and bounded
inline text/formula hunks. Normalized paths retain an exact `sourcePath` when needed. Doc alignment
has independent context pagination; Sheet row/column alignment uses compact native index runs.
Callers can select `summary`, `changes`, or `full` detail without changing
item identity. See the [Agent diff contract and executable example](packages/collab-gateway-contract/README.md#agent-diff-contract).

The operational Skills ship with Univer CLI so their commands and Facade guidance match the installed application version.

## CLI capabilities

The Skill selects these capabilities automatically. Most users do not need to call them manually.

| Commands                                           | Purpose                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `new`, `import`                                    | Create a `.univer` file or import Office content                                  |
| `status`, `unit`                                   | Inspect file status and manage Sheet, Doc, Slide, Base, or Board Units            |
| `worktree`                                         | Create, prepare, reopen, merge, or discard isolated changes                       |
| `inspect`                                          | Read Workbook, Worksheet, Range, Document, Paragraph, Presentation, or Slide data |
| `execute`                                          | Read or edit content through trusted Univer Facade code                           |
| `screenshot`, `print-pdf`, `lint`                  | Render content, print PDF, and diagnose Slide or Board layout issues              |
| `compile-svg`, `compile-typst`, `compile-markdown` | Turn SVG, Typst, or Markdown sources into editable Univer content                 |
| `export-markdown`                                  | Read selected current Modern Doc blocks into Markdown, assets, and a revision map |
| `export`, `open`                                   | Export Office files or return a local Viewer URL                                  |
| `api`, `resources`, `skills`                       | Find Facade APIs, visual resources, and operational guidance                      |
| `config`, `doctor`, `update`, `daemon`, `optimize` | Configure, diagnose, update, run, and maintain the local application              |

See the [complete CLI reference](apps/cli/README.md) for command options, selectors, environment variables, machine output, and process behavior.

Board rendered/both `lint` accepts opt-in `--maximum-automatic-label-distance <board-units>`.
The limit must be finite and non-negative, including zero. Missing native support or unresolved distance
is incomplete; exceeded limits are errors, and either exits 2. The native sampled, marker-trimmed
stroke-centerline metric is not raster ink and preserves fixed/authored and endpoint-role labels.
Inspection never moves labels.

Board rendered/both `lint --plan-ports` returns native read-only port-order plans in `analyses[].portPlan`.
Missing or incomplete planning makes coverage incomplete. Apply one ready plan through the Board Facade,
then lint a fresh snapshot before using another plan. Original findings remain visible until rechecked.

## Requirements and current limits

- An agent that supports Agent Skills, plus Node.js 24.0 or later and npm/npx.
- Screenshot, PDF printing, Slide and rendered Board layout lint, and browser text measurement require Chrome, Chromium, or Edge. The agent can prepare the browser through `univer screenshot setup`.
- `execute` runs trusted JavaScript and is not a sandbox for untrusted code.
- `.univer` files, the Gateway, Viewer, daemon, runtime workers, and browser cache stay on the local machine. Explicit HTTP imports, resource downloads, and update checks can access the network.
- Board supports structural and visual verification but does not currently support file import or export.

## Architecture

Univer CLI is built on the [Univer SDK](https://docs.univer.ai/). This repository assembles the SDK into a local Office CLI for agents and implements the application-specific capabilities for `.univer` files, the Gateway, Viewer, process management, and safe data upgrades.

`apps/cli` is the only public application, and `univer` is its only program and binary. Private `packages/*` projects support the application and are not parallel products.

See the [architecture guide](docs/architecture.md) for SDK boundaries, runtime processes, and package responsibilities.

## Data and security

A `.univer` file uses SQLite to store Units, revisions, Worktrees, local resources, and a rebuildable History index. Supported earlier formats are upgraded only after read-only identification, a byte-for-byte backup, independent candidate verification, and atomic replacement. A failed upgrade never overwrites the source. Opening the same unchanged file again reuses that backup.

The bundled Univer runtime development license is an application credential for the `localhost`, `app`, and `127.0.0.1` domains, made of a License and the key the server SDKs verify it with, and authorized for redistribution with this application. It rotates every 90 days and is separate from the repository software license.

## Development

The project requires Node.js 24.0 or later and the pnpm version declared in `package.json`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dream-num/univer-cli.git
cd univer-cli
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm link:cli
pnpm check
```

Stop the daemon before unlinking a local build:

```bash
univer daemon stop
pnpm unlink:cli
```

Daemon startup initializes the local Gateway. Standard headless Univer composition loads when a content worker
or document-authoring request needs it; document-authoring instances are disposed after each request.

### Local Board integration

Use `pnpm dev:board --map <sdk-tarballs.json>` to verify unpublished SDK tarballs with the source CLI, an isolated
file/daemon home, and a browser bundle reused only when its inputs match. See
[local Board development](docs/board-local-development.md) for package provenance, producer dev packing,
temporary configuration recovery, and interactive CLI/Viewer entrypoints.
Validation follows transitive SDK dependencies and checks that installed runtime entry bytes match the supplied tarballs.

### SDK upgrades

Every `@univerjs`, `@univerjs-pro`, and `@univer-cli` dependency shares one exact version baseline.
Upgrade it with:

```bash
pnpm update:univer-sdk --sdk_version <exact-sdk-version>
```

The updater rewrites every matching declaration to the target version and strips any workspace
overrides for those scopes. `@univerjs/icons`, `@univerjs-pro/cli-assets`, and
`@univerjs-pro/doc-typst-native-binding` keep their own version rules. Native bindings are never
declared directly; they install transitively through their wrappers. Commit every affected manifest
together with `pnpm-lock.yaml`; partial manual SDK updates are not allowed.

## License

[Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Univer Pro SDK packages, runtime credentials, native bindings, and other third-party components retain their own terms.

repository.readme:
> 🌐 **简体中文** | [English](README_EN.md)

> ⚠️ 仅用于数据分析与风险管理，不做自动交易、不预测涨跌、不构成任何投资建议。 > > 🚧 本项目处于活跃开发阶段。功能可能会发生变化，某些功能也可能会失效。如果您遇到问题或有好的想法，请[提交 Issue](https://github.com/Euzohn/ZFundPilot/issues)。欢迎贡献代码！ --- ## 截图

首页门户 — 深色战术终端风格，核心指标 + 快捷导航 + 系统状态


组合总览 — 持仓成本、市值、盈亏一览 + 资产/渠道/板块分布图 + 数据状态提示（最新正式净值日期、需关注净值基金数、T+1 待确认交易数）


持仓明细 — 按基金合并的跨渠道持仓视图，净值日期标注新鲜度


更多截图（点击展开）

持仓明细（网格视图） — Bento 大卡布局，占比条 + 成本/估值/盈亏 + 持仓天数/板块


交易管理 — 交易录入、流水查看、CSV 导入导出、截图导入（AI 视觉模型识别交易/持仓）、定投计划自动执行


净值更新 — 天天基金优先、AkShare 兜底，批量拉取净值历史


收益分析 — 浮动/已实现盈亏、XIRR 年化收益、组合收益曲线、基准对比、日/周/月/年日历视图


组合体检 — 四维诊断评分（配置/风险/流动性/收益）+ 风险提示 + 可解释行动清单


基金对比 — 多维度同框对比 + 净值走势叠加 + 相关性矩阵


基金筛选 — 全市场筛选 + Top 30 指标增强，列头可排序


自选关注 — 追踪关注基金，已持有的标「持仓中」badge，列头可排序


定投回测 — DCA vs 一次性投入，XIRR 年化、最大回撤、夏普比率


设置 — 账户管理、AI 配置、偏好设置、审计日志

## 这是什么 ZFundPilot 是一个**自托管的中国基金组合分析工具**。记录每一笔交易，自动拉取净值，计算收益与风险，给出结构优化建议。不是交易系统，不做自动买卖，不连接券商。 ## 为什么不同 - **自托管，数据归你** — 本地运行或 Docker 部署，数据存在自己手里，不上传任何第三方 - **中国市场专精** — 数据源来自 AkShare 和天天基金，支持中国基金的全维度分析（含实时估值、费率计算、板块分类） - **数据驱动分析** — 不是荐基平台，没有排行榜和营销话术，只有基于你持仓数据的量化指标 - **AI 辅助，不是 AI 决策** — OpenAI 兼容 API 提供持仓上下文问答，建议仅供参考，决策在你自己 - **Agent 可读，也可审计** — 独立 Agent token + MCP 适配层，让 Claude Desktop / Cursor 在明确的 scope、限流与审计边界内读取组合、维护自选、提交待审批提案或（可信 Token）直接记录已确认的单笔交易，而不是把整站 API 暴露给模型 ## 快速开始 ### Docker（最快） ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` 浏览器打开 http://localhost:8000 ### 本地开发 ```bash # 后端 API pip install -e . uvicorn zfundpilot.api:app --reload --port 8000 # 前端开发服务器（另一个终端） cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev ``` > Windows 原生运行同样支持（自动安装 `tzdata`）；注意 SQLite 本地时间取宿主机时区， > 建议与应用时区（默认 `Asia/Shanghai`）保持一致，详见 [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md)。 详细部署指南见 [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md)。 ## 功能亮点 ### 交易与持仓 - **交易流水管理** — 记录买入/卖出/分红/再投资/转换，表单录入 + CSV 批量导入/导出 + 全量数据备份导出 ZIP（格式 v2，含净值历史与逐表校验，可预检后恢复） - **基金转换** — 一次录入转出基金（卖出）和转入基金（买入），原子创建两条关联交易，转出份额带持有量校验，赎回费/申购费分别自动计算，转换记录在流水中带标识，点击标识可跳转配对腿详情 - **多渠道支持** — 支付宝、理财通、天天基金等，同一基金不同渠道分开计算成本 - **手续费自动查询** — 录入交易时自动从天天基金拉取申购/赎回费率，按金额分档匹配，卖出按 FIFO 计算赎回费，支持手动覆盖 - **持仓自动汇总** — 按「基金 + 渠道」用移动加权平均成本法汇总，卖出时结转已实现收益 - **持仓明细视图** — 列表视图（跨渠道明细 + 净值新鲜度 + 自定义展示列）与网格视图（Bento 大卡 + 占比条 + 成本/估值/盈亏/持仓天数/板块）自由切换 - **行业穿透（基金穿透）** — 跨基金聚合底层持仓的真实行业敞口（证监会分类），揭示组合真实行业分布而非基金名称推导。持仓页行业敞口 Tab 含穿透覆盖度、BarChart + PieChart + 明细表；基金详情页展示单基金行业配置饼图。AI 投顾上下文注入行业穿透数据 ### 分析与估值 - **净值更新** — 天天基金优先，AkShare 兜底，输入代码自动获取名称/类型/板块 - **收益分析** — 浮动盈亏、已实现盈亏、XIRR 年化收益（组合 + 单基金，现金流二分法）、组合收益曲线、基准对比（沪深300/上证指数/创业板指 + CPI 购买力/M2 财富排位水位线，数据持久化离线可用）、收益率排序（累计/年化切换）、日/周/月/年日历视图、按渠道堆叠柱状图 - **财富水位线（CPI/M2）** — 组合收益曲线叠加通胀购买力线（CPI 环比链乘价格水平）与社会财富排位线（M2 存量扩张），回答「扣掉通胀我真的变富了吗」。水位线以建仓日前最后月末为基期，建仓日精确为 0。AI 投顾上下文注入实际收益（扣通胀）与社会财富排位升降 - **实时估值** — 交易日实时估算基金涨跌幅，组合估算 P&L 一目了然，真实净值公布后自动失效。主源无数据时自动走天天基金 fundgz 替补（6 线程并行），指数/ETF 行情兜底 - **基金对比** — 多维度同框对比 + 净值走势叠加 + 相关性矩阵。对比篮全局管理，随时增减，导航栏显示数量 badge - **基金筛选器** — 从全市场基金池按类型/板块/关键词筛选，Top 30 自动补充收益/风险指标与机构持有比例，列头可排序，一键加入对比或自选；指数型基金标宽基/行业/主题徽章，并展示近 1 年迷你走势 - **指数估值** — 12 个宽基指数的 PE/PB 百分位与估值温度（PE(TTM) 百分位 <30 低估 / 30–70 合理 / >70 高估），默认近 10 年窗口（历史不足用全历史并标注），可展开历史曲线与跟踪基金；列头 ⓘ 悬停解释 PE/PB/百分位/温度含义；数据源韭圈儿（主）+ 乐咕（备），完整日频历史（2008 年起），24h 缓存 + 失败降级，仅供参考 - **自选关注列表** — 追踪关注基金，已持有的自动标「持仓中」badge，列头可排序，添加代码自动获取名称/类型/板块，快捷跳转详情/对比/买入 - **截图导入** — 上传购买记录或持仓截图，AI 视觉模型自动识别交易/持仓。持仓对账模式按渠道对比已记录份额，一键生成差额调整交易。视觉模型独立配置（智谱 GLM-4V / 通义千问 VL / GPT-4o / Kimi 视觉），截图只有名称时自动匹配代码 - **基金详情** — 净值走势 + 资产配置饼图 + 前十大重仓股 + 同类排名走势 + 基金档案（基金经理/规模/成立时间/持有人结构）+ 风险等级 + 顶栏快捷入口（加入对比/自选/买入/卖出/定投） - **定投策略回测** — 指定基金 + 时间区间 + 频率（月/双周/周），用历史净值回测定投 vs 一次性投入，计算 XIRR 年化、最大回撤、夏普比率 - **定投计划自动执行** — 设置每日/每周/每双周/每月自动买入，遇非交易日顺延（A 股交易日历，含法定节假日/调休），自动计算手续费，T+1 回填净值。执行前校验基金申购状态（暂停申购/限购/低于起点自动跳过，次日重试） ### 组合体检与优化 - **组合体检** — 四维诊断评分（配置/风险/流动性/收益，每维 0-100）+ 综合定级（优秀→危险），复用风险指标 + 结构建议，一个 API 返回全量 - **结构建议（行动清单）** — 基于组合结构给出再平衡建议（非交易指令），每条可展开四段可解释结构：依据（指标值 vs 阈值）、涉及持仓、模拟调整前后（what-if 假设演算，非操作指令）、风险与限制 - **止盈止损提醒** — 净值更新后自动检查持仓收益率，达到阈值时生成提醒。状态机防重复：触发后需收益率回落到复位线以下才再次提醒，避免部分止盈后重复骚扰。止盈/止损独立开关，全局阈值可配置。确认跳转交易页预填卖出 - **分红自动检测** — 每天 09:30 自动扫描持仓基金分红事件，弹窗预填确认入账。幽灵提醒自动清理：源数据修正后自动标记无效提醒为 ignored - **统一通知中心** — 侧栏/顶栏 Bell 未读徽章 + 通知抽屉：分红、止盈止损、定投跳过/失败、刷新任务失败、净值更新失败与数据健康异常统一聚合，按来源分组、去重不重发；单条已读/全部已读/忽略，点击跳转来源页处理，源已删除显示「已失效」；提醒确认/忽略后通知状态自动联动。通知写入失败不影响任何主业务 - **风险等级展示** — 基金风险等级（低/中低/中/中高/高）持久化后全站展示：持仓列表风险色点 badge + 风险等级筛选 + 语义排序，纵览页风险分布饼图，收益页单基金色点，组合体检页风险等级分布占比条 ### AI 辅助 - **AI 投顾对话** — 配置 OpenAI 兼容 API（智谱/Kimi/通义千问/DeepSeek），AI 自动联网搜索最新资讯 + 结合持仓数据给出调仓建议 - **AI 录入交易** — 自然语言描述交易，AI 自动解析结构化数据并计算手续费，确认后写入 ### Agent 接入（API / MCP） **已支持** - **独立 Agent 令牌** — 与网页登录 token 物理隔离的高熵 token，服务端只存 SHA-256 摘要；按只读与可选写 scope 授权，默认拒绝、可撤销/过期，无密码模式下不可签发 - **26 个只读工具** — 组合汇总、数据状态、持仓、基金详情、体检、收益、对比、流水、自选、提醒、计划、曲线、基准、风险、行业敞口、检索、筛选、回测、作业状态与能力发现；统一响应包与正式净值口径，不写账本（其中预检类工具仍受写开关约束） - **写开关总闸** — Agent 写能力默认关闭，网页「设置 → Agent 接入」可随时开关（需登录密码确认、持久化、重启保持），无密码模式禁止开启 - **受控写入：自选 / 刷新 / 可信直记** — 自选维护（`watchlist:write`）与净值/元数据刷新（`data:refresh`）直接执行；`record_transaction`（`transactions:create`）在限额内直记用户**明确陈述已在外部平台完成**的单笔普通买卖，预检异常自动降级为待审批提案 - **审批记账：提案工具** — `create_operation_proposal` 等 4 个工具按 `transactions:propose`/`plans:propose`/`alerts:propose` 只提交待审批提案，覆盖单笔新增/修改/删除、基金转换与整对删除、**批量导入**、分红提醒关联、定投计划创建/更新/启停/删除、交易净值回填、提醒处理与定投手动执行；管理员网页确认后服务端在同一事务内复核并写入账本/计划/提醒状态，永不绕过审批；修改/删除/启停/提醒处理/回填/定投手动执行用 `row_digest` 版本前置防并发覆盖。定投手动执行只新增一笔买入并推进计划簿记，不重算 `next_run`、不触发调度器 - **CSV/截图预检、对账与回填预检** — 提交提案前先校验 CSV/条目与持仓对账，或盘点可回填净值的候选流水，只返回报告，不写账本、不联网、不创建提案 - **MCP 适配层** — 可选 stdio 桥接（`python -m zfundpilot.mcp_server`），让 Claude Desktop / Cursor 在 scope 边界内调用，鉴权/scope/限流复用 HTTP 入口 - **可审计边界** — 鉴权成功/失败、限流、签发与撤销均写审计（仅记 token 前缀），按 token + 端点限流，远程访问要求 HTTPS；所有响应带 `X-Request-ID`，错误体提供稳定 `error.code` 与 `retryable`。端点、示例与配置见 [docs/AGENT_API.md](docs/AGENT_API.md) > **边界**：ZFundPilot 是个人基金分析与风险管理工具，**不做自动交易、不接入券商下单、不预测涨跌**。Agent 只能读数据、维护自选、刷新净值，或在授权后记录**用户已在外部平台完成**的交易；可信直记是管理员对 Token 的**预授权**，不代表服务端验证了本次对话已获人类确认，也不构成对任何交易的推荐。 **规划中（未上线，非承诺）** - **P3 Phase 3** — 行动清单条目转待审批提案（人工网页确认，不生成交易指令）；估值择时联动（分档变化提醒 + 低估多投/高估少投历史回测参考，不预测、不自动调整）；站外通知（Webhook/邮件）最后评估，默认最小披露且默认不启用（可解释行动清单与统一通知中心已上线） ### 安全与自定义 - **密码认证** — 用户名 + 密码登录，HMAC 签名 token，bcrypt 密码哈希，登录速率限制防爆破 - **API Key 加密存储** — AI API key 落盘自动加密（Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256），主密钥 `data/secret.key` 权限 0o600；加密用于防止单个配置文件被直接读取，无法防止整个 `data/` 目录被读取，请限制目录权限。远程 AI 端点要求 HTTPS，明文 HTTP 仅允许本机回环地址 - **审计日志** — 敏感操作记入日志，设置页可查看 - **中英文切换** — 全站界面支持中英文切换，侧边栏一键切换，数据格式（¥/$、相对时间）自动适配 - **涨跌颜色切换** — 支持「绿涨红跌（国际）」/「红涨红跌（A 股）」双主题，服务端同步 - **暗色模式** — light/dark/system 三态切换，默认跟随系统偏好 - **渠道颜色自定义** — 预设色板 + 自由选色，服务端同步 - **关键词映射自定义** — 板块/类型分类规则开放给用户编辑，多设备同步 ## 使用流程 1. **交易录入** → 输入基金代码，自动补全信息，选择操作类型和渠道，保存 2. **净值更新** → 点击「更新全部基金净值」拉取历史数据，或启用定时任务自动更新 3. **持仓与分析** → 查看持仓明细、收益曲线、风险指标与结构建议 4. **AI 辅助** → 配置 API 后对话咨询，或让 AI 帮你录入交易 > 买入填金额（净值自动填充，份额自动倒算），卖出填份额（金额自动倒算），分红填金额，再投资填份额+净值。 ## 技术栈 | 层 | 技术 | |---|---| | 前端 | React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui | | 后端 | FastAPI + SQLite + Pandas | | 数据源 | AkShare + 天天基金 | | AI | OpenAI 兼容 API（智谱 / Kimi / 通义千问 / DeepSeek） | | 部署 | Docker / Uvicorn | ## 项目结构

GitHub Actions CI/CD │ └── ci.yml # ruff → pytest → tsc → build ├── src/zfundpilot/ # Python 包 │ ├── __init__.py │ ├── config.py # 全局配置、渠道、风险阈值、认证/AI 配置存储 │ ├── models.py # 数据结构（Fund / Transaction / Position） │ ├── db.py # SQLite 数据库操作 │ ├── fetch_fund.py # 净值获取 + 名称/类型/板块识别 + 费率查询 + 关键词映射 + 持仓/排名/档案/行业配置 │ ├── fetch_estimate.py # 基金实时估值（AkShare fund_value_estimation_em） │ ├── fetch_macro.py # 宏观财富水位（CPI 价格水平 + M2 存量） │ ├── fetch_dividend.py # ## 环境变量
点击展开 | 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 | |------|--------|------| | `ZFUNDPILOT_USERNAME` | `admin` | 仅首次启动时初始化登录用户名 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_PASSWORD` | 空 | 仅首次启动时初始化密码哈希（bcrypt） | | `ZFUNDPILOT_SECRET` | 自动生成 | 仅首次启动时初始化 token 签名密钥 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_NAV_CRON` | `0 21 * * 1-5` | 净值定时更新 cron 表达式 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_HOME` | 项目根 | 数据目录所在位置 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | 空 | 信任代理网段（仅 Nginx/Caddy 反代后配置） | | `CONTAINER_NAME` | `zfundpilot` | Docker 容器名称，多实例部署时需为每个实例设置不同名称（详见 DEPLOY.md） |
## 安全
点击展开 | 措施 | 说明 | |------|------| | 密码哈希 | bcrypt（cost=12），兼容旧版 SHA-256，登录后自动升级 | | 登录限流 | 5 分钟内失败 5 次锁定 15 分钟 | | Token 认证 | HMAC-SHA256 签名，7 天有效期，改密后立即失效 | | Agent token | 独立高熵随机串，仅存 SHA-256 摘要，scope 白名单默认拒绝，可撤销/过期 | | 错误脱敏 | AI 上游错误不暴露给客户端 | | 信任代理 | `ZFUNDPILOT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` 控制，默认空（不信任任何代理） | - **纯 IP / 局域网**：设密码即可，默认配置安全 - **域名 + HTTPS**：推荐 Caddy 自动 TLS，配置 `TRUSTED_PROXIES` - **Agent token**：仅通过 `Authorization: Bearer` 传递，不要放进 URL、前端持久存储或模型提示词；远程使用必须走 HTTPS
## CSV 列说明（交易流水）
点击展开 | 列名 | 说明 | 必填 | |------|------|------| | fund_code | 基金代码 | ✅ | | action | 操作类型（买入/卖出/分红/再投资，也识别 buy/sell/dividend/reinvest） | ✅ | | date | 成交日期 YYYY-MM-DD | ✅ | | amount | 成交金额 | 买入/分红必填 | | shares | 成交份额 | 卖出/再投资必填 | | nav | 成交净值 | 填二缺一可自动补全 | | fee | 手续费 | | | channel | 渠道 | | | note | 备注 | | `amount` / `shares` / `nav` 填写任意两列即可，自动补全第三列。支持中文表头。
## 风险阈值
点击展开 | 指标 | 默认阈值 | |------|---------| | 单基金占比偏高 / 过高 | 20% / 40% | | 债券最低占比 | 10% | | QDII 海外暴露 | 30% | | 权益类偏重 | 70% | | 高风险回撤 | -15% | | 高波动率 | 25% | 默认阈值定义在 `config.py` 的 `RiskThresholds`，可按需调整。
## 更新日志 详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 贡献 欢迎提交 [Issues](https://github.com/Euzohn/ZFundPilot/issues) 报告问题或提出新需求，也欢迎提交 [Pull Requests](https://github.com/Euzohn/ZFundPilot/pulls) 一起改进。 **作者邮箱**：[Zongid@outlook.com](mailto:Zongid@outlook.com) ## License MIT License © 2025 Euzohn 数据来源与合规声明见 [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md)。 --- ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=Euzohn/ZFundPilot&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#Euzohn/ZFundPilot&Date)

name: CI

on:
  push:
    # 功能/修复/基建分支推送即跑 CI，支持「分支检测通过 → 再合并 main」流程
    branches: [main, "feat/**", "fix/**", "chore/**"]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

# 避免同一分支重复并发导致资源争用；新提交会取消旧运行
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# 默认 shell，避免每步重复指定
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Ruff check
        run: ruff check src tests

      - name: Pytest
        run: pytest -v -x

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci

      - name: TypeScript check
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Build
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm run build

      - name: Frontend tests
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm test

# ─── 前端构建 ───
FROM node:22-slim AS frontend-build
WORKDIR /app/frontend
COPY frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json ./
RUN npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com && \
    npm ci
COPY frontend/ ./
RUN npm run build

# ─── 后端运行 ───
FROM python:3.11-slim AS backend
WORKDIR /app

# 设置时区为 Asia/Shanghai（修复 datetime.now() 返回 UTC 的问题）
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tzdata libjpeg62-turbo && \
    ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# 安装后端依赖（使用阿里云 PyPI 镜像加速）
# requirements.txt 与源码分离，依赖不变时 pip install 层缓存命中
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    -i https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple \
    --trusted-host mirrors.aliyun.com

# 拷贝源码
COPY src/ src/
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src

# 复制前端构建产物
COPY --from=frontend-build /app/frontend/dist frontend/dist/

# 复制数据目录（首次启动自动建表）
RUN mkdir -p data

# 非 root 运行：新建 zfundpilot 用户（UID 1000）并把数据目录属主交给他。
# bind mount（./data:/app/data）会遮蔽镜像内属主，宿主机目录需 chown 一致（见 DEPLOY.md）。
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 zfundpilot && \
    chown zfundpilot:zfundpilot /app/data
USER zfundpilot

EXPOSE 8000

CMD ["uvicorn", "zfundpilot.api:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

## 这是什么 ZFundPilot 是一个**自托管的中国基金组合分析工具**。记录每一笔交易，自动拉取净值，计算收益与风险，给出结构优化建议。不是交易系统，不做自动买卖，不连接券商。 ## 为什么不同 - **自托管，数据归你** — 本地运行或 Docker 部署，数据存在自己手里，不上传任何第三方 - **中国市场专精** — 数据源来自 AkShare 和天天基金，支持中国基金的全维度分析（含实时估值、费率计算、板块分类） - **数据驱动分析** — 不是荐基平台，没有排行榜和营销话术，只有基于你持仓数据的量化指标 - **AI 辅助，不是 AI 决策** — OpenAI 兼容 API 提供持仓上下文问答，建议仅供参考，决策在你自己 - **Agent 可读，也可审计** — 独立 Agent token + MCP 适配层，让 Claude Desktop / Cursor 在明确的 scope、限流与审计边界内读取组合、维护自选、提交待审批提案或（可信 Token）直接记录已确认的单笔交易，而不是把整站 API 暴露给模型 ## 快速开始 ### Docker（最快） ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` 浏览器打开 http://localhost:8000 ### 本地开发 ```bash # 后端 API pip install -e . uvicorn zfundpilot.api:app --reload --port 8000 # 前端开发服务器（另一个终端） cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev ``` > Windows 原生运行同样支持（自动安装 `tzdata`）；注意 SQLite 本地时间取宿主机时区， > 建议与应用时区（默认 `Asia/Shanghai`）保持一致，详见 [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md)。 详细部署指南见 [DEPLOY.md](DEPLOY.md)。 ## 功能亮点 ### 交易与持仓 - **交易流水管理** — 记录买入/卖出/分红/再投资/转换，表单录入 + CSV 批量导入/导出 + 全量数据备份导出 ZIP（格式 v2，含净值历史与逐表校验，可预检后恢复） - **基金转换** — 一次录入转出基金（卖出）和转入基金（买入），原子创建两条关联交易，转出份额带持有量校验，赎回费/申购费分别自动计算，转换记录在流水中带标识，点击标识可跳转配对腿详情 - **多渠道支持** — 支付宝、理财通、天天基金等，同一基金不同渠道分开计算成本 - **手续费自动查询** — 录入交易时自动从天天基金拉取申购/赎回费率，按金额分档匹配，卖出按 FIFO 计算赎回费，支持手动覆盖 - **持仓自动汇总** — 按「基金 + 渠道」用移动加权平均成本法汇总，卖出时结转已实现收益 - **持仓明细视图** — 列表视图（跨渠道明细 + 净值新鲜度 + 自定义展示列）与网格视图（Bento 大卡 + 占比条 + 成本/估值/盈亏/持仓天数/板块）自由切换 - **行业穿透（基金穿透）** — 跨基金聚合底层持仓的真实行业敞口（证监会分类），揭示组合真实行业分布而非基金名称推导。持仓页行业敞口 Tab 含穿透覆盖度、BarChart + PieChart + 明细表；基金详情页展示单基金行业配置饼图。AI 投顾上下文注入行业穿透数据 ### 分析与估值 - **净值更新** — 天天基金优先，AkShare 兜底，输入代码自动获取名称/类型/板块 - **收益分析** — 浮动盈亏、已实现盈亏、XIRR 年化收益（组合 + 单基金，现金流二分法）、组合收益曲线、基准对比（沪深300/上证指数/创业板指 + CPI 购买力/M2 财富排位水位线，数据持久化离线可用）、收益率排序（累计/年化切换）、日/周/月/年日历视图、按渠道堆叠柱状图 - **财富水位线（CPI/M2）** — 组合收益曲线叠加通胀购买力线（CPI 环比链乘价格水平）与社会财富排位线（M2 存量扩张），回答「扣掉通胀我真的变富了吗」。水位线以建仓日前最后月末为基期，建仓日精确为 0。AI 投顾上下文注入实际收益（扣通胀）与社会财富排位升降 - **实时估值** — 交易日实时估算基金涨跌幅，组合估算 P&L 一目了然，真实净值公布后自动失效。主源无数据时自动走天天基金 fundgz 替补（6 线程并行），指数/ETF 行情兜底 - **基金对比** — 多维度同框对比 + 净值走势叠加 + 相关性矩阵。对比篮全局管理，随时增减，导航栏显示数量 badge - **基金筛选器** — 从全市场基金池按类型/板块/关键词筛选，Top 30 自动补充收益/风险指标与机构持有比例，列头可排序，一键加入对比或自选；指数型基金标宽基/行业/主题徽章，并展示近 1 年迷你走势 - **指数估值** — 12 个宽基指数的 PE/PB 百分位与估值温度（PE(TTM) 百分位 <30 低估 / 30–70 合理 / >70 高估），默认近 10 年窗口（历史不足用全历史并标注），可展开历史曲线与跟踪基金；列头 ⓘ 悬停解释 PE/PB/百分位/温度含义；数据源韭圈儿（主）+ 乐咕（备），完整日频历史（2008 年起），24h 缓存 + 失败降级，仅供参考 - **自选关注列表** — 追踪关注基金，已持有的自动标「持仓中」badge，列头可排序，添加代码自动获取名称/类型/板块，快捷跳转详情/对比/买入 - **截图导入** — 上传购买记录或持仓截图，AI 视觉模型自动识别交易/持仓。持仓对账模式按渠道对比已记录份额，一键生成差额调整交易。视觉模型独立配置（智谱 GLM-4V / 通义千问 VL / GPT-4o / Kimi 视觉），截图只有名称时自动匹配代码 - **基金详情** — 净值走势 + 资产配置饼图 + 前十大重仓股 + 同类排名走势 + 基金档案（基金经理/规模/成立时间/持有人结构）+ 风险等级 + 顶栏快捷入口（加入对比/自选/买入/卖出/定投） - **定投策略回测** — 指定基金 + 时间区间 + 频率（月/双周/周），用历史净值回测定投 vs 一次性投入，计算 XIRR 年化、最大回撤、夏普比率 - **定投计划自动执行** — 设置每日/每周/每双周/每月自动买入，遇非交易日顺延（A 股交易日历，含法定节假日/调休），自动计算手续费，T+1 回填净值。执行前校验基金申购状态（暂停申购/限购/低于起点自动跳过，次日重试） ### 组合体检与优化 - **组合体检** — 四维诊断评分（配置/风险/流动性/收益，每维 0-100）+ 综合定级（优秀→危险），复用风险指标 + 结构建议，一个 API 返回全量 - **结构建议（行动清单）** — 基于组合结构给出再平衡建议（非交易指令），每条可展开四段可解释结构：依据（指标值 vs 阈值）、涉及持仓、模拟调整前后（what-if 假设演算，非操作指令）、风险与限制 - **止盈止损提醒** — 净值更新后自动检查持仓收益率，达到阈值时生成提醒。状态机防重复：触发后需收益率回落到复位线以下才再次提醒，避免部分止盈后重复骚扰。止盈/止损独立开关，全局阈值可配置。确认跳转交易页预填卖出 - **分红自动检测** — 每天 09:30 自动扫描持仓基金分红事件，弹窗预填确认入账。幽灵提醒自动清理：源数据修正后自动标记无效提醒为 ignored - **统一通知中心** — 侧栏/顶栏 Bell 未读徽章 + 通知抽屉：分红、止盈止损、定投跳过/失败、刷新任务失败、净值更新失败与数据健康异常统一聚合，按来源分组、去重不重发；单条已读/全部已读/忽略，点击跳转来源页处理，源已删除显示「已失效」；提醒确认/忽略后通知状态自动联动。通知写入失败不影响任何主业务 - **风险等级展示** — 基金风险等级（低/中低/中/中高/高）持久化后全站展示：持仓列表风险色点 badge + 风险等级筛选 + 语义排序，纵览页风险分布饼图，收益页单基金色点，组合体检页风险等级分布占比条 ### AI 辅助 - **AI 投顾对话** — 配置 OpenAI 兼容 API（智谱/Kimi/通义千问/DeepSeek），AI 自动联网搜索最新资讯 + 结合持仓数据给出调仓建议 - **AI 录入交易** — 自然语言描述交易，AI 自动解析结构化数据并计算手续费，确认后写入 ### Agent 接入（API / MCP） **已支持** - **独立 Agent 令牌** — 与网页登录 token 物理隔离的高熵 token，服务端只存 SHA-256 摘要；按只读与可选写 scope 授权，默认拒绝、可撤销/过期，无密码模式下不可签发 - **26 个只读工具** — 组合汇总、数据状态、持仓、基金详情、体检、收益、对比、流水、自选、提醒、计划、曲线、基准、风险、行业敞口、检索、筛选、回测、作业状态与能力发现；统一响应包与正式净值口径，不写账本（其中预检类工具仍受写开关约束） - **写开关总闸** — Agent 写能力默认关闭，网页「设置 → Agent 接入」可随时开关（需登录密码确认、持久化、重启保持），无密码模式禁止开启 - **受控写入：自选 / 刷新 / 可信直记** — 自选维护（`watchlist:write`）与净值/元数据刷新（`data:refresh`）直接执行；`record_transaction`（`transactions:create`）在限额内直记用户**明确陈述已在外部平台完成**的单笔普通买卖，预检异常自动降级为待审批提案 - **审批记账：提案工具** — `create_operation_proposal` 等 4 个工具按 `transactions:propose`/`plans:propose`/`alerts:propose` 只提交待审批提案，覆盖单笔新增/修改/删除、基金转换与整对删除、**批量导入**、分红提醒关联、定投计划创建/更新/启停/删除、交易净值回填、提醒处理与定投手动执行；管理员网页确认后服务端在同一事务内复核并写入账本/计划/提醒状态，永不绕过审批；修改/删除/启停/提醒处理/回填/定投手动执行用 `row_digest` 版本前置防并发覆盖。定投手动执行只新增一笔买入并推进计划簿记，不重算 `next_run`、不触发调度器 - **CSV/截图预检、对账与回填预检** — 提交提案前先校验 CSV/条目与持仓对账，或盘点可回填净值的候选流水，只返回报告，不写账本、不联网、不创建提案 - **MCP 适配层** — 可选 stdio 桥接（`python -m zfundpilot.mcp_server`），让 Claude Desktop / Cursor 在 scope 边界内调用，鉴权/scope/限流复用 HTTP 入口 - **可审计边界** — 鉴权成功/失败、限流、签发与撤销均写审计（仅记 token 前缀），按 token + 端点限流，远程访问要求 HTTPS；所有响应带 `X-Request-ID`，错误体提供稳定 `error.code` 与 `retryable`。端点、示例与配置见 [docs/AGENT_API.md](docs/AGENT_API.md) > **边界**：ZFundPilot 是个人基金分析与风险管理工具，**不做自动交易、不接入券商下单、不预测涨跌**。Agent 只能读数据、维护自选、刷新净值，或在授权后记录**用户已在外部平台完成**的交易；可信直记是管理员对 Token 的**预授权**，不代表服务端验证了本次对话已获人类确认，也不构成对任何交易的推荐。 **规划中（未上线，非承诺）** - **P3 Phase 3** — 行动清单条目转待审批提案（人工网页确认，不生成交易指令）；估值择时联动（分档变化提醒 + 低估多投/高估少投历史回测参考，不预测、不自动调整）；站外通知（Webhook/邮件）最后评估，默认最小披露且默认不启用（可解释行动清单与统一通知中心已上线） ### 安全与自定义 - **密码认证** — 用户名 + 密码登录，HMAC 签名 token，bcrypt 密码哈希，登录速率限制防爆破 - **API Key 加密存储** — AI API key 落盘自动加密（Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256），主密钥 `data/secret.key` 权限 0o600；加密用于防止单个配置文件被直接读取，无法防止整个 `data/` 目录被读取，请限制目录权限。远程 AI 端点要求 HTTPS，明文 HTTP 仅允许本机回环地址 - **审计日志** — 敏感操作记入日志，设置页可查看 - **中英文切换** — 全站界面支持中英文切换，侧边栏一键切换，数据格式（¥/$、相对时间）自动适配 - **涨跌颜色切换** — 支持「绿涨红跌（国际）」/「红涨红跌（A 股）」双主题，服务端同步 - **暗色模式** — light/dark/system 三态切换，默认跟随系统偏好 - **渠道颜色自定义** — 预设色板 + 自由选色，服务端同步 - **关键词映射自定义** — 板块/类型分类规则开放给用户编辑，多设备同步 ## 使用流程 1. **交易录入** → 输入基金代码，自动补全信息，选择操作类型和渠道，保存 2. **净值更新** → 点击「更新全部基金净值」拉取历史数据，或启用定时任务自动更新 3. **持仓与分析** → 查看持仓明细、收益曲线、风险指标与结构建议 4. **AI 辅助** → 配置 API 后对话咨询，或让 AI 帮你录入交易 > 买入填金额（净值自动填充，份额自动倒算），卖出填份额（金额自动倒算），分红填金额，再投资填份额+净值。 ## 技术栈 | 层 | 技术 | |---|---| | 前端 | React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui | | 后端 | FastAPI + SQLite + Pandas | | 数据源 | AkShare + 天天基金 | | AI | OpenAI 兼容 API（智谱 / Kimi / 通义千问 / DeepSeek） | | 部署 | Docker / Uvicorn | ## 项目结构

## 环境变量
点击展开 | 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 | |------|--------|------| | `ZFUNDPILOT_USERNAME` | `admin` | 仅首次启动时初始化登录用户名 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_PASSWORD` | 空 | 仅首次启动时初始化密码哈希（bcrypt） | | `ZFUNDPILOT_SECRET` | 自动生成 | 仅首次启动时初始化 token 签名密钥 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_NAV_CRON` | `0 21 * * 1-5` | 净值定时更新 cron 表达式 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_HOME` | 项目根 | 数据目录所在位置 | | `ZFUNDPILOT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | 空 | 信任代理网段（仅 Nginx/Caddy 反代后配置） | | `CONTAINER_NAME` | `zfundpilot` | Docker 容器名称，多实例部署时需为每个实例设置不同名称（详见 DEPLOY.md） |
## 安全
点击展开 | 措施 | 说明 | |------|------| | 密码哈希 | bcrypt（cost=12），兼容旧版 SHA-256，登录后自动升级 | | 登录限流 | 5 分钟内失败 5 次锁定 15 分钟 | | Token 认证 | HMAC-SHA256 签名，7 天有效期，改密后立即失效 | | Agent token | 独立高熵随机串，仅存 SHA-256 摘要，scope 白名单默认拒绝，可撤销/过期 | | 错误脱敏 | AI 上游错误不暴露给客户端 | | 信任代理 | `ZFUNDPILOT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` 控制，默认空（不信任任何代理） | - **纯 IP / 局域网**：设密码即可，默认配置安全 - **域名 + HTTPS**：推荐 Caddy 自动 TLS，配置 `TRUSTED_PROXIES` - **Agent token**：仅通过 `Authorization: Bearer` 传递，不要放进 URL、前端持久存储或模型提示词；远程使用必须走 HTTPS
## CSV 列说明（交易流水）
点击展开 | 列名 | 说明 | 必填 | |------|------|------| | fund_code | 基金代码 | ✅ | | action | 操作类型（买入/卖出/分红/再投资，也识别 buy/sell/dividend/reinvest） | ✅ | | date | 成交日期 YYYY-MM-DD | ✅ | | amount | 成交金额 | 买入/分红必填 | | shares | 成交份额 | 卖出/再投资必填 | | nav | 成交净值 | 填二缺一可自动补全 | | fee | 手续费 | | | channel | 渠道 | | | note | 备注 | | `amount` / `shares` / `nav` 填写任意两列即可，自动补全第三列。支持中文表头。
## 风险阈值
点击展开 | 指标 | 默认阈值 | |------|---------| | 单基金占比偏高 / 过高 | 20% / 40% | | 债券最低占比 | 10% | | QDII 海外暴露 | 30% | | 权益类偏重 | 70% | | 高风险回撤 | -15% | | 高波动率 | 25% | 默认阈值定义在 `config.py` 的 `RiskThresholds`，可按需调整。

services:
  zfundpilot:
    build: .
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME:-zfundpilot}
    restart: always
    # 容器内以非 root 运行（镜像内置 USER zfundpilot / UID 1000）。
    # 若 bind mount 的数据目录属主不是 1000，用 PUID/PGID 覆盖（.env 里设置）；
    # 设 PUID=0 可退回 root 运行（故障排查逃生门，不推荐长期使用）。
    user: "${PUID:-1000}:${PGID:-1000}"
    env_file: .env
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

repository.readme: # GIMP MCP [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0) [![Works with Claude Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/Works%20with-Claude%20Desktop-7B2CBF.svg)](https://claude.ai/desktop) [![GIMP 3.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/GIMP-3.2-orange.svg)](https://gimp.org) [![MCP Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Compatible-green.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![CodeRabbit](https://img.shields.io/badge/CodeRabbit-AI%20Review-171717?logo=coderabbit)](https://coderabbit.ai) ## Demo ![GIMP MCP in action — AI agent driving GIMP through natural language](docs/mcpInAction.gif) Full demo (with audio): https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp/raw/main/docs/demo.mp4 *AI agent using GIMP MCP to remove a background, edit a character's expression, and verify results — all through natural language via Claude* --- ## Overview GIMP MCP bridges GIMP's professional image editing capabilities with AI assistants through the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io). It lets you edit images by describing what you want — and gives the AI a live visual feedback channel to verify each change before moving on. **What makes it different from other GIMP integrations:** - The AI can *see* the image at any point in the workflow without saving to disk (`get_state_snapshot`) - Supports fully autonomous multi-step pipelines: open → edit → verify → refine → export - 80 dedicated tool commands covering every major GIMP operation - Fully compatible with GIMP 3.2.x (all breaking API changes resolved) ## Key Features | | | |---|---| | 👁️ **Live Visual Feedback** | `get_state_snapshot` returns a PNG preview mid-workflow so the AI verifies each step | | 🎨 **80 GIMP Tools** | Adjustments, transforms, selections, layers, drawing, text, filters — all via MCP | | 🔧 **GIMP 3.2 Compatible** | All GIMP 3.2 API breaks fixed and tested by `run_tests.py` | | 🔁 **Iterative Workflows** | AI loops until a goal is met — e.g. keeps removing BG until no pixels remain | | 🖼️ **Region Snapshots** | Zoom into any area for detail verification (face, mouth, corner, etc.) | | 🔌 **Universal MCP** | Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, PydanticAI, and more | ## What Can It Do? ### Background Removal with Iterative Verification The AI removes the background, takes a snapshot to inspect the result, detects remaining pixels, and loops until the image is clean: ``` "Remove the background from this image and keep looping until only the character remains" ``` ### Expression Editing ``` "Make the character smile — paint a smile arc with teeth over her mouth" ``` ### Complex Multi-Step Pipelines ``` "Open navi_portrait.png, remove the background, verify it's clean, then make her smile and export the final result as a PNG" ``` ### Color & Tone Work ``` "Boost the contrast, shift the hue 15 degrees warmer, then show me a before/after zoom of the face" ``` ### Text & Compositing ``` "Add a bold title at the top in white with a subtle drop shadow, then export for web" ``` --- ## Prerequisites - **GIMP 3.2+** — tested on GIMP 3.2.2 (Windows, macOS, Linux) - **uv** — Python package manager ([install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)); `uvx` downloads the MCP server and a suitable Python (3.11+) on first use - **MCP-compatible AI client** — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, PydanticAI, etc. --- ## Quick Start The MCP server and the GIMP plugin ship together as the [`gimp-mcp-plugin`](https://pypi.org/project/gimp-mcp-plugin/) package on PyPI. No clone needed. ### 1. Install the GIMP Plugin Launch GIMP once (so its config folder exists), close it, then run: ```bash uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin ``` This copies the plugin into the newest GIMP 3.x config folder it finds (Linux standard, Snap and Flatpak locations, macOS, Windows) and makes it executable. Restart GIMP afterward. - `--dry-run` shows where it would install without writing anything. - `--gimp-dir DIR` installs into a specific GIMP config folder, e.g. `--gimp-dir ~/.config/GIMP/3.2`. If you have more than one GIMP 3 installation (e.g. a system GIMP and a Flatpak), the newest folder found may not be the one your GIMP uses. Check the folder shown in GIMP's **Edit → Preferences → Folders → Plug-ins** and pass the folder that contains `plug-ins` with `--gimp-dir`. > **Which folder does GIMP use?** GIMP names its per-user folder after its **major.minor** > version (`3.0`, `3.2`, `3.4`, …) and creates a fresh one on each minor upgrade, so the > plug-ins folder *moves* when you upgrade GIMP. Re-run `install-plugin` after upgrading. > To check the active path, open **Edit → Preferences → Folders → Plug-ins** in GIMP. ### 2. Start the MCP Server in GIMP 1. Open any image in GIMP 2. Go to **Tools > MCP > Start MCP Server** 3. Server starts on `localhost:9877` #### Start automatically when GIMP launches To skip step 2 on every launch, open **Tools > MCP > MCP Server Settings...**, tick **Start MCP server when GIMP launches**, and restart GIMP. Autostart is off by default. The same dialog sets the **port** (default `9877`). If you change it, set `GIMP_MCP_PORT` in your MCP client config so the MCP server connects to the same port: ```json "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"], "env": { "GIMP_MCP_PORT": "9988" } } ``` Settings are saved to `gimp-mcp.json` in GIMP's per-user config folder (e.g. `~/.config/GIMP/3.2/gimp-mcp.json`). Port changes apply the next time the server starts. #### Timeout for long commands The MCP server waits up to 300 seconds for GIMP to finish each command. For heavier work (large or 16-bit images, slow filters), set `GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT` (in seconds) in your MCP client config, the same way as `GIMP_MCP_PORT` above, e.g. `"GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT": "900"`. `check_server` reports the timeout in effect. When a command times out, GIMP may still be running it, so check the image before retrying. Your MCP client may have its own tool timeout (in Claude Code, `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT`, in milliseconds); raise it too if it's shorter. ### 3. Configure Your MCP Client `gimp-mcp-plugin@latest` makes `uvx` check PyPI for a new release each time your client starts the server. #### Claude Desktop `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` (Linux/macOS) or `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` (Windows): ```json { "mcpServers": { "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"] } } } ``` #### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add gimp-mcp -- uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest ``` #### Gemini CLI `~/.config/gemini/.gemini_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"] } } } ``` #### PydanticAI ```python from pydantic_ai import Agent from pydantic_ai.mcp import MCPServerStdio server = MCPServerStdio('uvx', args=['gimp-mcp-plugin@latest']) agent = Agent('openai:gpt-4o', mcp_servers=[server]) ``` #### Cancelling long commands GIMP runs one command at a time, in the order they're sent. While it works, the MCP server stays responsive, so your client can cancel a call. The cancel returns at once: a command that's still waiting its turn never runs, but one GIMP has already started is finished in the background. Check the image before retrying a cancelled edit, or it may be applied twice. ### Updating The plugin and the MCP server must be the same version. `check_server` and `get_gimp_info` report a mismatch and print the command that fixes it. To update both: 1. Restart your MCP client. With `@latest`, it picks up the newest server. 2. Run `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin` and restart GIMP. ### Running from a Git Checkout (contributors) To work on the code, run the server and install the plugin from a clone instead: ```bash git clone https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp.git cd gimp-mcp uv sync uv run gimp_mcp_server.py install-plugin # installs this checkout's plugin ``` Then point your MCP client at the checkout, e.g. for Claude Desktop: ```json "gimp": { "command": "uv", "args": ["run", "--directory", "/full/path/to/gimp-mcp", "gimp_mcp_server.py"] } ``` Claude Code picks up the repo's `.mcp.json` automatically when started in the checkout. After `git pull`, re-run `install-plugin` if the plugin changed. --- ## Available MCP Tools ### 👁️ Visual Feedback #### `get_state_snapshot(image_index, max_size, region, label)` Returns a live PNG of the current image state — the AI's primary feedback mechanism. Call this between any edits to verify the result without saving to disk. ```python # Full image snapshot snapshot = get_state_snapshot(max_size=512) # Zoom into a face region for detail inspection snapshot = get_state_snapshot( region={"x": 140, "y": 80, "width": 240, "height": 300}, max_size=512, label="face-check" ) ``` This enables iterative agentic workflows: **edit → snapshot → assess → refine → repeat**. #### `get_image_bitmap(image_index, max_width, max_height, region)` Lower-level bitmap fetch with region extraction and scaling. Returns base64-encoded PNG. ### 🎨 Adjustments | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `adjust_brightness_contrast` | Brightness and contrast | | `adjust_curves` | Curves by channel (RGB/R/G/B/A) | | `adjust_hue_saturation` | Hue, saturation, lightness | | `adjust_color_balance` | Shadows/midtones/highlights color balance | | `auto_levels` | Auto-stretch levels | | `desaturate` | Convert to grayscale (keep RGB mode) | | `invert_colors` | Invert all channels | | `convert_color_mode` | Convert between RGB, grayscale, and indexed modes | | `sharpen` | Unsharp mask sharpening | | `blur` | Gaussian blur | | `denoise` | Noise reduction | ### 🔄 Transforms | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `scale_image` | Scale to exact dimensions | | `scale_to_fit` | Scale within bounding box (aspect-safe) | | `crop_to_rect` | Crop to rectangle | | `crop_to_selection` | Crop canvas to the current selection bounds | | `rotate_image` | Rotate 90/180/270 or arbitrary angle | | `flip_image` | Flip horizontal or vertical | | `resize_canvas` | Resize canvas without scaling content | | `warp_region` | Warp / liquify a region by pushing pixels in a direction | ### ✂️ Selections | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `select_rectangle` | Rectangular marquee | | `select_ellipse` | Elliptical marquee | | `select_by_color` | Select by color (global); anti-aliased edges need a higher `threshold` or a `modify_selection` grow | | `select_all` / `select_none` | Select all / deselect | | `invert_selection` | Invert selection | | `modify_selection` | Grow, shrink, feather, or border | ### 🗂️ Layers | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `create_layer` | New empty layer | | `duplicate_layer` | Duplicate a layer (default: the selected one) | | `delete_layer` | Delete named layer | | `rename_layer` | Rename layer | | `set_layer_properties` | Opacity, blend mode, visibility | | `reorder_layer` | Move layer in stack | | `merge_visible_layers` | Flatten visible to one layer | | `flatten_image` | Flatten all layers | | `list_layers` | List all layers with properties | ### 🖌️ Drawing & Fill | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `fill_layer` | Fill entire layer with color | | `fill_selection` | Fill selection (foreground/background/transparent) | | `fill_rectangle` | Fill a rectangle region | | `fill_ellipse` | Fill an ellipse region | | `draw_line` | Draw a line (pencil or paintbrush) | | `draw_rectangle` | Draw a rectangle outline | | `draw_ellipse` | Draw an ellipse outline | | `gradient_fill` | Apply linear or radial gradient | | `set_colors` | Set foreground/background colors | ### 🔤 Text | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `add_text` | Add a text layer | | `edit_text` | Edit existing text layer | | `list_fonts` | List available fonts | ### ✨ Filters & Effects | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `apply_gaussian_blur` | Gaussian blur filter | | `apply_pixelate` | Pixelate/mosaic effect | | `apply_emboss` | Emboss effect | | `apply_vignette` | Vignette darkening | | `apply_noise` | Add noise/grain | | `apply_drop_shadow` | Drop shadow effect | ### 📁 File Operations | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `open_image` | Open image file | | `open_image_as_layer` | Import an image file as a new layer in an open image | | `export_image` | Export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP | | `save_xcf` | Save as GIMP XCF (preserves layers and metadata) | | `new_canvas` | Create blank canvas | | `close_image` | Close image | | `list_images` | List open images | | `set_active_image` | Bring a specific open image to the front | ### 📦 Batch & Multi-Format Export | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `batch_export` | Export all open images (or one) to a directory | | `batch_resize` | Resize all open images to a common size | | `export_web_optimized` | Export as JPEG and PNG, keeping the smaller | | `export_icon_sizes` | Export a full Android or iOS icon set | | `export_social_media_kit` | Export resized versions for social media platforms | | `export_sprite_sheet` | Combine frames into a sprite sheet PNG | ### ↩️ History | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `undo` | Not supported on GIMP 3.x: returns an error (use Ctrl+Z in GIMP) | | `redo` | Not supported on GIMP 3.x: returns an error (use Ctrl+Y in GIMP) | ### 🔍 Info & Context | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `get_image_metadata` | Image size, mode, layers, filename | | `get_gimp_info` | GIMP version, platform, capabilities | | `get_context_state` | Current colors, brush, opacity, mode | | `get_pixel_color` | Color value at a specific pixel | | `get_histogram` | Histogram data for a channel | | `get_selection_bounds` | Current selection bounds | ### 🔌 Connection & Raw API | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `check_server` | Check the GIMP plugin socket is reachable and that the plugin version matches the server | | `restart_server` | Drop and re-establish the connection to the plugin | | `call_api` | Run arbitrary Python-Fu code inside GIMP (escape hatch for anything not covered above) | --- ## AI Agent Feedback Loop The `get_state_snapshot` tool enables a pattern where the AI loops until a goal is visually confirmed: ```text ┌─────────────┐ │ Apply edit │ └──────┬──────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ get_state_ │ ← AI sees live PNG, no disk save needed │ snapshot() │ └──────┬──────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ │ Goal achieved? │─ No─▶ Adjust & retry │ └──────┬──────────┘ └──────────────────┘ │ Yes ▼ ┌─────────────┐ │ Export │ └─────────────┘ ``` ### Example: Iterative Background Removal See [`bg_remove_iterative.py`](bg_remove_iterative.py) for a complete example. The AI: 1. Removes the background using edge-seeded contiguous select 2. Takes a snapshot to check the result 3. Scans for remaining background-colored pixels 4. Runs targeted removal passes with progressively finer grids (25px → 1px) 5. Runs a final despeckle pass for isolated pixels 6. Loops until no background pixels remain --- ## Example Scripts | Script | Description | |---|---| | [`run_tests.py`](run_tests.py) | Test suite — run against your GIMP to verify all tools work | | [`bg_remove_iterative.py`](bg_remove_iterative.py) | Iterative BG removal with snapshot checkpoints | | [`bg_remove.py`](bg_remove.py) | Simple single-pass background removal | | [`agent_edit_demo.py`](agent_edit_demo.py) | Full pipeline: open → remove BG → edit expression → export | | [`tests/test_add_text_metadata.py`](tests/test_add_text_metadata.py) | Regression test: `add_text` returns real layer metadata | | [`tests/continuous_edit_test/continuous_edit_test.py`](tests/continuous_edit_test/continuous_edit_test.py) | End-to-end agent editing loop: BG removal, selective recolor, composite | Run the test suite to verify your setup: ```bash python run_tests.py # Expected: === TOTAL: N/N PASSED === (every test passes) ``` --- ## Technical Architecture ### Plugin ↔ Server Communication ```text AI Client (Claude, etc.) │ MCP (stdio) ▼ gimp_mcp_server.py ← MCP tool definitions │ TCP JSON :9877 ▼ gimp-mcp-plugin.py ← Runs inside GIMP process │ PyGObject ▼ GIMP 3.2 (gi.repository.Gimp) ``` - MCP server translates tool calls into JSON commands sent to the plugin over TCP - Plugin executes operations directly in the GIMP process via PyGObject - Two message formats: `{"type": "...", "params": {...}}` for named tools, `{"cmds": ["python..."]}` for arbitrary exec ### GIMP 3.2 Compatibility Notes GIMP 3.x introduced breaking API changes from GIMP 2.x. Key fixes included in this release: | Issue | Fix | |---|---| | `layer.copy(False)` → error | `layer.copy()` takes no args in GIMP 3.2 | | `Gimp.text_fontname()` and PDB `gimp-text-fontname` removed | Use `Gimp.TextLayer.new()` (PDB `gimp-text-font` as a fallback) | | `gimp-blend` removed | Use `drawable.edit_gradient_fill()` (PDB `gimp-drawable-edit-gradient-fill`). `gegl:linear-gradient` and `gegl:radial-gradient` are source operations, which `Gimp.DrawableFilter` can't apply | | `gimp-levels-stretch`, `plug-in-gauss`, `plug-in-unsharp-mask`, `plug-in-iwarp` removed | `gimp-drawable-levels-stretch`; GEGL filters (`gegl:gaussian-blur`, `gegl:unsharp-mask`, ...) through `Gimp.DrawableFilter`; `warp_region` runs `gegl:warp` in its own GEGL graph, since `Gimp.DrawableFilter` can't apply it | | GEGL filter properties aren't on the filter | Set them on `filter.get_config()`, then call `filter.update()` and `drawable.merge_filter(filter)` | | `GimpDoubleArray` TypeError in curves | Use `drawable.curves_spline()` directly | | `Gimp.fonts_get_list()` returns `Font` objects | Convert via `.get_name()` before JSON serialization | | `image.select_none()` removed | Use `Gimp.Selection.none(image)` | | `layer.get_pixel()` returns `Gegl.Color` | Use `.get_rgba()` to extract float components | | `Gimp.get_displays()` removed | The plugin keeps track of the displays it opens | | The PDB has no undo/redo procedure | `undo` and `redo` return an error saying so | | `Gegl.Color.new()` misreads most colors | It turns unknown names (e.g. `orange`) into cyan and reads `rgb()` values as linear, so the plugin parses colors itself and passes hex | --- ## Troubleshooting ### "Could not connect to GIMP" - GIMP must be running with an image open - Start the MCP server: **Tools > MCP > Start MCP Server**, or enable autostart in **Tools > MCP > MCP Server Settings...** - If you changed the port in GIMP, set `GIMP_MCP_PORT` to the same value in your MCP client config - Check port 9877 (or your custom port) is not blocked by firewall ### "GIMP did not reply within 300 s" - The command took longer than the MCP server waits. Raise `GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT` (seconds) in your MCP client config; see [Timeout for long commands](#timeout-for-long-commands) - GIMP may still be running the command: check the image before retrying ### Plugin Not Visible in GIMP - Look under **Tools > MCP** (the plugin adds an `MCP` submenu, not a top-level `Tools` entry) - Confirm the plugin file is in the correct directory: `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin --dry-run` shows where it goes - **Upgraded GIMP recently?** A minor upgrade (e.g. 3.0 → 3.2) moves the per-user config folder to a new version directory; re-run `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin` (use `--dry-run` to see which folder it picks). Verify the active path via **Edit > Preferences > Folders > Plug-ins**. - On Linux/macOS: ensure the file has execute permission (`chmod +x`) - Restart GIMP after installation - Check **Filters > Script-Fu > Console** for error messages ### Tests Failing Run the test suite and check the failure list: ```bash python run_tests.py ``` Each failure includes the tool name and error — most issues on GIMP 3.2 are covered by the fixes above. --- ## Example Output *"Draw me a face and a sheep" — generated entirely through natural language via GIMP MCP* --- ## Future Enhancements - **📚 Recipe Collection**: Reusable workflow templates (portrait cleanup, product photo, etc.) - **🚀 Dynamic Discovery**: Auto-generate MCP tools from GIMP's full PDB procedure database - **🔒 Security**: Sandboxed execution for untrusted command inputs - **⚡ Performance**: Optimized bitmap transfer for large images - **🌐 Remote Access**: Network-accessible GIMP instances --- ## Contributing Contributions are welcome — bug fixes, new tools, documentation, or example scripts. Open a PR or issue on GitHub. ### Development Setup Install dev dependencies and activate the pre-commit hook so `ruff` runs on every commit: ```bash uv sync uv run pre-commit install ``` After this, `ruff` checks staged files on each `git commit` (with `--fix` applied automatically). The same check runs in CI, so the hook is just a fast local safety net. To bump the pinned hook versions later: ```bash uv run pre-commit autoupdate ``` ## License GPL-3.0-or-later. sampled_files.README.md: # GIMP MCP [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0) [![Works with Claude Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/Works%20with-Claude%20Desktop-7B2CBF.svg)](https://claude.ai/desktop) [![GIMP 3.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/GIMP-3.2-orange.svg)](https://gimp.org) [![MCP Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Compatible-green.svg)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![CodeRabbit](https://img.shields.io/badge/CodeRabbit-AI%20Review-171717?logo=coderabbit)](https://coderabbit.ai) ## Demo ![GIMP MCP in action — AI agent driving GIMP through natural language](docs/mcpInAction.gif) Full demo (with audio): https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp/raw/main/docs/demo.mp4 *AI agent using GIMP MCP to remove a background, edit a character's expression, and verify results — all through natural language via Claude* --- ## Overview GIMP MCP bridges GIMP's professional image editing capabilities with AI assistants through the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io). It lets you edit images by describing what you want — and gives the AI a live visual feedback channel to verify each change before moving on. **What makes it different from other GIMP integrations:** - The AI can *see* the image at any point in the workflow without saving to disk (`get_state_snapshot`) - Supports fully autonomous multi-step pipelines: open → edit → verify → refine → export - 80 dedicated tool commands covering every major GIMP operation - Fully compatible with GIMP 3.2.x (all breaking API changes resolved) ## Key Features | | | |---|---| | 👁️ **Live Visual Feedback** | `get_state_snapshot` returns a PNG preview mid-workflow so the AI verifies each step | | 🎨 **80 GIMP Tools** | Adjustments, transforms, selections, layers, drawing, text, filters — all via MCP | | 🔧 **GIMP 3.2 Compatible** | All GIMP 3.2 API breaks fixed and tested by `run_tests.py` | | 🔁 **Iterative Workflows** | AI loops until a goal is met — e.g. keeps removing BG until no pixels remain | | 🖼️ **Region Snapshots** | Zoom into any area for detail verification (face, mouth, corner, etc.) | | 🔌 **Universal MCP** | Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, PydanticAI, and more | ## What Can It Do? ### Background Removal with Iterative Verification The AI removes the background, takes a snapshot to inspect the result, detects remaining pixels, and loops until the image is clean: ``` "Remove the background from this image and keep looping until only the character remains" ``` ### Expression Editing ``` "Make the character smile — paint a smile arc with teeth over her mouth" ``` ### Complex Multi-Step Pipelines ``` "Open navi_portrait.png, remove the background, verify it's clean, then make her smile and export the final result as a PNG" ``` ### Color & Tone Work ``` "Boost the contrast, shift the hue 15 degrees warmer, then show me a before/after zoom of the face" ``` ### Text & Compositing ``` "Add a bold title at the top in white with a subtle drop shadow, then export for web" ``` --- ## Prerequisites - **GIMP 3.2+** — tested on GIMP 3.2.2 (Windows, macOS, Linux) - **uv** — Python package manager ([install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)); `uvx` downloads the MCP server and a suitable Python (3.11+) on first use - **MCP-compatible AI client** — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, PydanticAI, etc. --- ## Quick Start The MCP server and the GIMP plugin ship together as the [`gimp-mcp-plugin`](https://pypi.org/project/gimp-mcp-plugin/) package on PyPI. No clone needed. ### 1. Install the GIMP Plugin Launch GIMP once (so its config folder exists), close it, then run: ```bash uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin ``` This copies the plugin into the newest GIMP 3.x config folder it finds (Linux standard, Snap and Flatpak locations, macOS, Windows) and makes it executable. Restart GIMP afterward. - `--dry-run` shows where it would install without writing anything. - `--gimp-dir DIR` installs into a specific GIMP config folder, e.g. `--gimp-dir ~/.config/GIMP/3.2`. If you have more than one GIMP 3 installation (e.g. a system GIMP and a Flatpak), the newest folder found may not be the one your GIMP uses. Check the folder shown in GIMP's **Edit → Preferences → Folders → Plug-ins** and pass the folder that contains `plug-ins` with `--gimp-dir`. > **Which folder does GIMP use?** GIMP names its per-user folder after its **major.minor** > version (`3.0`, `3.2`, `3.4`, …) and creates a fresh one on each minor upgrade, so the > plug-ins folder *moves* when you upgrade GIMP. Re-run `install-plugin` after upgrading. > To check the active path, open **Edit → Preferences → Folders → Plug-ins** in GIMP. ### 2. Start the MCP Server in GIMP 1. Open any image in GIMP 2. Go to **Tools > MCP > Start MCP Server** 3. Server starts on `localhost:9877` #### Start automatically when GIMP launches To skip step 2 on every launch, open **Tools > MCP > MCP Server Settings...**, tick **Start MCP server when GIMP launches**, and restart GIMP. Autostart is off by default. The same dialog sets the **port** (default `9877`). If you change it, set `GIMP_MCP_PORT` in your MCP client config so the MCP server connects to the same port: ```json "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"], "env": { "GIMP_MCP_PORT": "9988" } } ``` Settings are saved to `gimp-mcp.json` in GIMP's per-user config folder (e.g. `~/.config/GIMP/3.2/gimp-mcp.json`). Port changes apply the next time the server starts. #### Timeout for long commands The MCP server waits up to 300 seconds for GIMP to finish each command. For heavier work (large or 16-bit images, slow filters), set `GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT` (in seconds) in your MCP client config, the same way as `GIMP_MCP_PORT` above, e.g. `"GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT": "900"`. `check_server` reports the timeout in effect. When a command times out, GIMP may still be running it, so check the image before retrying. Your MCP client may have its own tool timeout (in Claude Code, `MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT`, in milliseconds); raise it too if it's shorter. ### 3. Configure Your MCP Client `gimp-mcp-plugin@latest` makes `uvx` check PyPI for a new release each time your client starts the server. #### Claude Desktop `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` (Linux/macOS) or `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` (Windows): ```json { "mcpServers": { "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"] } } } ``` #### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add gimp-mcp -- uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest ``` #### Gemini CLI `~/.config/gemini/.gemini_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "gimp": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["gimp-mcp-plugin@latest"] } } } ``` #### PydanticAI ```python from pydantic_ai import Agent from pydantic_ai.mcp import MCPServerStdio server = MCPServerStdio('uvx', args=['gimp-mcp-plugin@latest']) agent = Agent('openai:gpt-4o', mcp_servers=[server]) ``` #### Cancelling long commands GIMP runs one command at a time, in the order they're sent. While it works, the MCP server stays responsive, so your client can cancel a call. The cancel returns at once: a command that's still waiting its turn never runs, but one GIMP has already started is finished in the background. Check the image before retrying a cancelled edit, or it may be applied twice. ### Updating The plugin and the MCP server must be the same version. `check_server` and `get_gimp_info` report a mismatch and print the command that fixes it. To update both: 1. Restart your MCP client. With `@latest`, it picks up the newest server. 2. Run `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin` and restart GIMP. ### Running from a Git Checkout (contributors) To work on the code, run the server and install the plugin from a clone instead: ```bash git clone https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp.git cd gimp-mcp uv sync uv run gimp_mcp_server.py install-plugin # installs this checkout's plugin ``` Then point your MCP client at the checkout, e.g. for Claude Desktop: ```json "gimp": { "command": "uv", "args": ["run", "--directory", "/full/path/to/gimp-mcp", "gimp_mcp_server.py"] } ``` Claude Code picks up the repo's `.mcp.json` automatically when started in the checkout. After `git pull`, re-run `install-plugin` if the plugin changed. --- ## Available MCP Tools ### 👁️ Visual Feedback #### `get_state_snapshot(image_index, max_size, region, label)` Returns a live PNG of the current image state — the AI's primary feedback mechanism. Call this between any edits to verify the result without saving to disk. ```python # Full image snapshot snapshot = get_state_snapshot(max_size=512) # Zoom into a face region for detail inspection snapshot = get_state_snapshot( region={"x": 140, "y": 80, "width": 240, "height": 300}, max_size=512, label="face-check" ) ``` This enables iterative agentic workflows: **edit → snapshot → assess → refine → repeat**. #### `get_image_bitmap(image_index, max_width, max_height, region)` Lower-level bitmap fetch with region extraction and scaling. Returns base64-encoded PNG. ### 🎨 Adjustments | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `adjust_brightness_contrast` | Brightness and contrast | | `adjust_curves` | Curves by channel (RGB/R/G/B/A) | | `adjust_hue_saturation` | Hue, saturation, lightness | | `adjust_color_balance` | Shadows/midtones/highlights color balance | | `auto_levels` | Auto-stretch levels | | `desaturate` | Convert to grayscale (keep RGB mode) | | `invert_colors` | Invert all channels | | `convert_color_mode` | Convert between RGB, grayscale, and indexed modes | | `sharpen` | Unsharp mask sharpening | | `blur` | Gaussian blur | | `denoise` | Noise reduction | ### 🔄 Transforms | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `scale_image` | Scale to exact dimensions | | `scale_to_fit` | Scale within bounding box (aspect-safe) | | `crop_to_rect` | Crop to rectangle | | `crop_to_selection` | Crop canvas to the current selection bounds | | `rotate_image` | Rotate 90/180/270 or arbitrary angle | | `flip_image` | Flip horizontal or vertical | | `resize_canvas` | Resize canvas without scaling content | | `warp_region` | Warp / liquify a region by pushing pixels in a direction | ### ✂️ Selections | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `select_rectangle` | Rectangular marquee | | `select_ellipse` | Elliptical marquee | | `select_by_color` | Select by color (global); anti-aliased edges need a higher `threshold` or a `modify_selection` grow | | `select_all` / `select_none` | Select all / deselect | | `invert_selection` | Invert selection | | `modify_selection` | Grow, shrink, feather, or border | ### 🗂️ Layers | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `create_layer` | New empty layer | | `duplicate_layer` | Duplicate a layer (default: the selected one) | | `delete_layer` | Delete named layer | | `rename_layer` | Rename layer | | `set_layer_properties` | Opacity, blend mode, visibility | | `reorder_layer` | Move layer in stack | | `merge_visible_layers` | Flatten visible to one layer | | `flatten_image` | Flatten all layers | | `list_layers` | List all layers with properties | ### 🖌️ Drawing & Fill | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `fill_layer` | Fill entire layer with color | | `fill_selection` | Fill selection (foreground/background/transparent) | | `fill_rectangle` | Fill a rectangle region | | `fill_ellipse` | Fill an ellipse region | | `draw_line` | Draw a line (pencil or paintbrush) | | `draw_rectangle` | Draw a rectangle outline | | `draw_ellipse` | Draw an ellipse outline | | `gradient_fill` | Apply linear or radial gradient | | `set_colors` | Set foreground/background colors | ### 🔤 Text | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `add_text` | Add a text layer | | `edit_text` | Edit existing text layer | | `list_fonts` | List available fonts | ### ✨ Filters & Effects | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `apply_gaussian_blur` | Gaussian blur filter | | `apply_pixelate` | Pixelate/mosaic effect | | `apply_emboss` | Emboss effect | | `apply_vignette` | Vignette darkening | | `apply_noise` | Add noise/grain | | `apply_drop_shadow` | Drop shadow effect | ### 📁 File Operations | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `open_image` | Open image file | | `open_image_as_layer` | Import an image file as a new layer in an open image | | `export_image` | Export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP | | `save_xcf` | Save as GIMP XCF (preserves layers and metadata) | | `new_canvas` | Create blank canvas | | `close_image` | Close image | | `list_images` | List open images | | `set_active_image` | Bring a specific open image to the front | ### 📦 Batch & Multi-Format Export | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `batch_export` | Export all open images (or one) to a directory | | `batch_resize` | Resize all open images to a common size | | `export_web_optimized` | Export as JPEG and PNG, keeping the smaller | | `export_icon_sizes` | Export a full Android or iOS icon set | | `export_social_media_kit` | Export resized versions for social media platforms | | `export_sprite_sheet` | Combine frames into a sprite sheet PNG | ### ↩️ History | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `undo` | Not supported on GIMP 3.x: returns an error (use Ctrl+Z in GIMP) | | `redo` | Not supported on GIMP 3.x: returns an error (use Ctrl+Y in GIMP) | ### 🔍 Info & Context | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `get_image_metadata` | Image size, mode, layers, filename | | `get_gimp_info` | GIMP version, platform, capabilities | | `get_context_state` | Current colors, brush, opacity, mode | | `get_pixel_color` | Color value at a specific pixel | | `get_histogram` | Histogram data for a channel | | `get_selection_bounds` | Current selection bounds | ### 🔌 Connection & Raw API | Tool | Description | |---|---| | `check_server` | Check the GIMP plugin socket is reachable and that the plugin version matches the server | | `restart_server` | Drop and re-establish the connection to the plugin | | `call_api` | Run arbitrary Python-Fu code inside GIMP (escape hatch for anything not covered above) | --- ## AI Agent Feedback Loop The `get_state_snapshot` tool enables a pattern where the AI loops until a goal is visually confirmed: ```text ┌─────────────┐ │ Apply edit │ └──────┬──────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ get_state_ │ ← AI sees live PNG, no disk save needed │ snapshot() │ └──────┬──────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ │ Goal achieved? │─ No─▶ Adjust & retry │ └──────┬──────────┘ └──────────────────┘ │ Yes ▼ ┌─────────────┐ │ Export │ └─────────────┘ ``` ### Example: Iterative Background Removal See [`bg_remove_iterative.py`](bg_remove_iterative.py) for a complete example. The AI: 1. Removes the background using edge-seeded contiguous select 2. Takes a snapshot to check the result 3. Scans for remaining background-colored pixels 4. Runs targeted removal passes with progressively finer grids (25px → 1px) 5. Runs a final despeckle pass for isolated pixels 6. Loops until no background pixels remain --- ## Example Scripts | Script | Description | |---|---| | [`run_tests.py`](run_tests.py) | Test suite — run against your GIMP to verify all tools work | | [`bg_remove_iterative.py`](bg_remove_iterative.py) | Iterative BG removal with snapshot checkpoints | | [`bg_remove.py`](bg_remove.py) | Simple single-pass background removal | | [`agent_edit_demo.py`](agent_edit_demo.py) | Full pipeline: open → remove BG → edit expression → export | | [`tests/test_add_text_metadata.py`](tests/test_add_text_metadata.py) | Regression test: `add_text` returns real layer metadata | | [`tests/continuous_edit_test/continuous_edit_test.py`](tests/continuous_edit_test/continuous_edit_test.py) | End-to-end agent editing loop: BG removal, selective recolor, composite | Run the test suite to verify your setup: ```bash python run_tests.py # Expected: === TOTAL: N/N PASSED === (every test passes) ``` --- ## Technical Architecture ### Plugin ↔ Server Communication ```text AI Client (Claude, etc.) │ MCP (stdio) ▼ gimp_mcp_server.py ← MCP tool definitions │ TCP JSON :9877 ▼ gimp-mcp-plugin.py ← Runs inside GIMP process │ PyGObject ▼ GIMP 3.2 (gi.repository.Gimp) ``` - MCP server translates tool calls into JSON commands sent to the plugin over TCP - Plugin executes operations directly in the GIMP process via PyGObject - Two message formats: `{"type": "...", "params": {...}}` for named tools, `{"cmds": ["python..."]}` for arbitrary exec ### GIMP 3.2 Compatibility Notes GIMP 3.x introduced breaking API changes from GIMP 2.x. Key fixes included in this release: | Issue | Fix | |---|---| | `layer.copy(False)` → error | `layer.copy()` takes no args in GIMP 3.2 | | `Gimp.text_fontname()` and PDB `gimp-text-fontname` removed | Use `Gimp.TextLayer.new()` (PDB `gimp-text-font` as a fallback) | | `gimp-blend` removed | Use `drawable.edit_gradient_fill()` (PDB `gimp-drawable-edit-gradient-fill`). `gegl:linear-gradient` and `gegl:radial-gradient` are source operations, which `Gimp.DrawableFilter` can't apply | | `gimp-levels-stretch`, `plug-in-gauss`, `plug-in-unsharp-mask`, `plug-in-iwarp` removed | `gimp-drawable-levels-stretch`; GEGL filters (`gegl:gaussian-blur`, `gegl:unsharp-mask`, ...) through `Gimp.DrawableFilter`; `warp_region` runs `gegl:warp` in its own GEGL graph, since `Gimp.DrawableFilter` can't apply it | | GEGL filter properties aren't on the filter | Set them on `filter.get_config()`, then call `filter.update()` and `drawable.merge_filter(filter)` | | `GimpDoubleArray` TypeError in curves | Use `drawable.curves_spline()` directly | | `Gimp.fonts_get_list()` returns `Font` objects | Convert via `.get_name()` before JSON serialization | | `image.select_none()` removed | Use `Gimp.Selection.none(image)` | | `layer.get_pixel()` returns `Gegl.Color` | Use `.get_rgba()` to extract float components | | `Gimp.get_displays()` removed | The plugin keeps track of the displays it opens | | The PDB has no undo/redo procedure | `undo` and `redo` return an error saying so | | `Gegl.Color.new()` misreads most colors | It turns unknown names (e.g. `orange`) into cyan and reads `rgb()` values as linear, so the plugin parses colors itself and passes hex | --- ## Troubleshooting ### "Could not connect to GIMP" - GIMP must be running with an image open - Start the MCP server: **Tools > MCP > Start MCP Server**, or enable autostart in **Tools > MCP > MCP Server Settings...** - If you changed the port in GIMP, set `GIMP_MCP_PORT` to the same value in your MCP client config - Check port 9877 (or your custom port) is not blocked by firewall ### "GIMP did not reply within 300 s" - The command took longer than the MCP server waits. Raise `GIMP_MCP_TIMEOUT` (seconds) in your MCP client config; see [Timeout for long commands](#timeout-for-long-commands) - GIMP may still be running the command: check the image before retrying ### Plugin Not Visible in GIMP - Look under **Tools > MCP** (the plugin adds an `MCP` submenu, not a top-level `Tools` entry) - Confirm the plugin file is in the correct directory: `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin --dry-run` shows where it goes - **Upgraded GIMP recently?** A minor upgrade (e.g. 3.0 → 3.2) moves the per-user config folder to a new version directory; re-run `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin@latest install-plugin` (use `--dry-run` to see which folder it picks). Verify the active path via **Edit > Preferences > Folders > Plug-ins**. - On Linux/macOS: ensure the file has execute permission (`chmod +x`) - Restart GIMP after installation - Check **Filters > Script-Fu > Console** for error messages ### Tests Failing Run the test suite and check the failure list: ```bash python run_tests.py ``` Each failure includes the tool name and error — most issues on GIMP 3.2 are covered by the fixes above. --- ## Example Output *"Draw me a face and a sheep" — generated entirely through natural language via GIMP MCP* --- ## Future Enhancements - **📚 Recipe Collection**: Reusable workflow templates (portrait cleanup, product photo, etc.) - **🚀 Dynamic Discovery**: Auto-generate MCP tools from GIMP's full PDB procedure database - **🔒 Security**: Sandboxed execution for untrusted command inputs - **⚡ Performance**: Optimized bitmap transfer for large images - **🌐 Remote Access**: Network-accessible GIMP instances --- ## Contributing Contributions are welcome — bug fixes, new tools, documentation, or example scripts. Open a PR or issue on GitHub. ### Development Setup Install dev dependencies and activate the pre-commit hook so `ruff` runs on every commit: ```bash uv sync uv run pre-commit install ``` After this, `ruff` checks staged files on each `git commit` (with `--fix` applied automatically). The same check runs in CI, so the hook is just a fast local safety net. To bump the pinned hook versions later: ```bash uv run pre-commit autoupdate ``` ## License GPL-3.0-or-later. name = "gimp-mcp-plugin"
version = "0.5.0"
description = "GIMP MCP integration for external control of GIMP 3.2"
readme = "README.md"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "mcp>=1.28.1,<2",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp"
Issues = "https://github.com/gimp-mcp/gimp-mcp/issues"

[project.scripts]
# `uvx gimp-mcp-plugin` runs the script named after the package.
gimp-mcp-plugin = "gimp_mcp_server:main"
gimp-mcp-server = "gimp_mcp_server:main"

[tool.setuptools]
# gimp-mcp-plugin.py is shipped too, for `gimp-mcp-plugin install-plugin` (it imports gi,
# which only exists inside GIMP, so it is never imported from the package).
py-modules = ["gimp_mcp_server", "gimp-mcp-plugin"]
# Ship docs/*.md (read by the MCP prompts) as the gimp_mcp_docs package, without moving them.
packages = ["gimp_mcp_docs"]
package-dir = { gimp_mcp_docs = "docs" }

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
gimp_mcp_docs = ["*.md"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"gimp-mcp-plugin.py" = ["E402"]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=4.5.1",
]

quality_controls.evidence: Canonical GitHub identity and retrieval timestamp
quality_controls.name: provenance
